question: L1₂構造を持つ化合物を一覧にして。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT me.formula AS chemical_formula
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
  regexp_replace(
    translate(upper(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
    '[^A-Z0-9]',
    '',
    'g'
  ) = 'L12'
  OR regexp_replace(
    translate(upper(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
    '[^A-Z0-9]',
    '',
    'g'
  ) IN ('L12', 'CU3AU')
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
ORDER BY chemical_formula
LIMIT 10000;

question: Niを含むL1₂型金属間化合物を抽出して。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT me.*, s.*
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system AS mas
  ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN alloy_system AS als
  ON als.alloy_system_id = mas.alloy_system_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND me.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      OR (
          s.space_group_number = 221
          AND s.formula_type IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
      )
  )
LIMIT 10000;

question: 形成エネルギーが負のL1₂型化合物を元素組み合わせごとに整理して。
sql:
SELECT
  (
    SELECT string_agg(ce.element, '-' ORDER BY ce.element)
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT c.element
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    ) AS ce
  ) AS element_combination,
  COUNT(*) AS compound_count,
  string_agg(
    me.formula || ' (' || ps.formation_energy_per_atom::text || ')',
    ', '
    ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom
  ) AS compounds
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  )
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
GROUP BY element_combination
ORDER BY element_combination
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Alに近い格子定数を持つL1₂化合物を探して。
sql:
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT s.lattice_a AS ref_a
  FROM material_entry AS me
  JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    )
    AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  me.entry_id AS material_id,
  me.formula,
  COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, s.prototype) AS structure_type,
  s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - ref.ref_a) AS delta_a_from_ni3al
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ref
WHERE (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  )
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND me.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
ORDER BY delta_a_from_ni3al ASC
LIMIT 20;

question: L1₂型化合物の形成エネルギー分布を教えて。
sql:
SELECT
  (floor(ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 0.1) * 0.1)::numeric(10, 2) AS formation_energy_bin_start_ev_per_atom,
  ((floor(ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 0.1) + 1) * 0.1)::numeric(10, 2) AS formation_energy_bin_end_ev_per_atom,
  count(*) AS compound_count
FROM phase_stability ps
JOIN material_entry me
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY floor(ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 0.1)
ORDER BY formation_energy_bin_start_ev_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

question: Aサイト元素ごとのL1₂型化合物数を集計して。

  WHERE
    upper(regexp_replace(translate(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%L12%'
    OR upper(regexp_replace(translate(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%L12%'
    OR upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%CU3AU%'
    OR upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%AUCU3%'
    OR (
      s.space_group_number = 221
      AND upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(s.formula_type, ''), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
    )
),
ranked_composition AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.element,
    c.atomic_fraction,
    c.site_label,
    upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(c.site_label, ''), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) IN ('A', 'ASITE', 'SITEA') AS is_a_site_label,
    bool_or(
      upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(c.site_label, ''), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) IN ('A', 'ASITE', 'SITEA')
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY c.entry_id) AS has_a_site_label,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.entry_id
      ORDER BY
        CASE
          WHEN c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80 THEN 0
          ELSE 1
        END,
        c.atomic_fraction DESC NULLS LAST,
        c.element
    ) AS inferred_a_rank
  FROM composition AS c
  JOIN l12_entries AS le
    ON c.entry_id = le.entry_id
)
SELECT
  element AS a_site_element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM ranked_composition
WHERE
  (has_a_site_label AND is_a_site_label)
  OR
  (NOT has_a_site_label AND inferred_a_rank = 1)
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC, a_site_element
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni基超合金のγ'相候補として有望な、安定または準安定なL1₂型化合物を抽出して。
sql:
WITH composition_summary AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        string_agg(element || atomic_fraction::text, ' ' ORDER BY element) AS composition_text,
        SUM(atomic_fraction) AS total_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
ni_composition AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        atomic_fraction AS ni_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition
    WHERE element = 'Ni'
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id AS material_id,
    me.formula,
    cs.composition_text AS composition,
    s.prototype,
    s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition_summary cs
    ON cs.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN ni_composition nc
    ON nc.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    )
    AND nc.ni_atomic_fraction / NULLIF(cs.total_atomic_fraction, 0) BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
    AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物において、Aサイト元素とBサイト元素の組み合わせが形成エネルギーに与える傾向を調べて。
sql:
WITH l12_materials AS (
  SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    MAX(c.element) FILTER (
      WHERE LOWER(c.site_label) IN ('a', 'a_site', 'a-site', 'a site')
    ) AS a_site_element,
    MAX(c.element) FILTER (
      WHERE LOWER(c.site_label) IN ('b', 'b_site', 'b-site', 'b site')
    ) AS b_site_element,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
  FROM material_entry me
  JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  JOIN composition c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    )
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    me.entry_id,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
)
SELECT
  a_site_element,
  b_site_element,
  COUNT(*) AS compound_count,
  AVG(formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy,
  STDDEV_SAMP(formation_energy_per_atom) AS stddev_formation_energy,
  MIN(formation_energy_per_atom) AS min_formation_energy,
  MAX(formation_energy_per_atom) AS max_formation_energy
FROM l12_materials
WHERE a_site_element IS NOT NULL
  AND b_site_element IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  a_site_element,
  b_site_element
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂構造を持つ化合物のうち、格子定数がNi₃Alに近く、形成エネルギーが低い候補を抽出して。
sql:
WITH composition_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.element,
    SUM(c.atomic_fraction) AS atomic_fraction
  FROM composition AS c
  GROUP BY c.entry_id, c.element
),
ni3al_entry AS (
  SELECT me.entry_id
  FROM material_entry AS me
  WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(COALESCE(me.formula, ''), ' ', '')) IN ('ni3al', 'alni3')
     OR LOWER(REPLACE(COALESCE(me.reduced_formula, ''), ' ', '')) IN ('ni3al', 'alni3')

  UNION

  SELECT ct.entry_id
  FROM composition_totals AS ct
  GROUP BY ct.entry_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ct.element) = 2
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN ct.element = 'Ni' THEN ct.atomic_fraction END) BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN ct.element = 'Al' THEN ct.atomic_fraction END) BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
),
ni3al AS (
  SELECT s.lattice_a AS a0
  FROM ni3al_entry AS ne
  JOIN material_entry AS me
    ON me.entry_id = ne.entry_id
  JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN (
        COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L1%2%'
        OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L1%₂%'
        OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '-', '')) = 'L12'
        OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '-', '')) LIKE '%L12%'
        OR (
          s.space_group_number = 221
          AND UPPER(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')) IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
        )
      )
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  me.entry_id AS material_id,
  me.formula,
  s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - n.a0) AS lattice_constant_diff,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - n.a0) / NULLIF(n.a0, 0) AS relative_lattice_constant_diff
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al AS n
WHERE (
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L1%2%'
    OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L1%₂%'
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '-', '')) = 'L12'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '-', '')) LIKE '%L12%'
    OR (
      s.space_group_number = 221
      AND UPPER(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')) IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
    )
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM ni3al_entry AS ne
    WHERE ne.entry_id = me.entry_id
  )
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND n.a0 IS NOT NULL
  AND n.a0 <> 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  relative_lattice_constant_diff ASC,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC;

      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1%2%'

    )
  ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST

)

  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN composition c
  ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE (
    regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
  )
  AND (
    ps.is_stable IS TRUE
    OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 1e-6
  )
  AND upper(trim(c.site_label)) LIKE 'A%'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

question: 格子定数3.55Å付近でバルクモジュラスの高いL1₂化合物を探して。
sql:
SELECT
  me.formula,
  s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant_angstrom,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON me.entry_id = et.entry_id
WHERE (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
    OR s.prototype IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
  )
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.50 AND 3.60
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55)
LIMIT 20;

question: L1₂型化合物の格子定数と形成エネルギーの相関を見たい。
sql:
SELECT
  me.formula,
  s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant_angstrom,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  corr(
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom::double precision,
    s.lattice_a::double precision
  ) OVER () AS pearson_correlation
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L1_2', 'L12')
    OR s.prototype IN ('L1₂', 'L1_2', 'L12')
  )
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.lattice_a
LIMIT 10000;

question: 準安定L1₂化合物をenergy above hull順にランキングして。

  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC) AS rank,
  me.source_material_id AS material_id,
  me.reduced_formula AS formula_pretty,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull > 0
  AND (

    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'

question: Bサイト元素ごとの安定L1₂化合物数を集計して。
sql:
WITH stable_l12_entries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id
  FROM material_entry AS me
  JOIN structure AS s
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry AS pde
    ON me.entry_id = pde.entry_id
  WHERE (
      UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '-', '')) LIKE '%L12%'
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '-', '')) LIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
    )
    AND (
      ps.is_stable IS TRUE
      OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 1e-5
      OR pde.is_on_hull IS TRUE
      OR pde.hull_distance <= 1e-5
    )
),
b_site_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    sle.entry_id,
    c.element,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY sle.entry_id
      ORDER BY
        CASE
          WHEN c.site_label ILIKE 'B%' THEN 0
          ELSE 1
        END,
        ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.25) NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM stable_l12_entries AS sle
  JOIN composition AS c
    ON sle.entry_id = c.entry_id
  WHERE c.element IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      c.site_label ILIKE 'B%'
      OR c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
    )
)
SELECT
  element AS b_site_element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM b_site_candidates
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC, b_site_element
LIMIT 10000;

question: DFT計算で得られたL1₂化合物の物性一覧を出して。

question: L1₂化合物の格子ミスマッチ（Ni3Alとの差）を計算して小さい順に表示して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.formula,
    s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant_a,
    ABS((s.lattice_a - ni3al.lattice_a) / ni3al.lattice_a) * 100 AS lattice_mismatch_percent
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
        s_ref.lattice_a
    FROM material_entry AS me_ref
    JOIN structure AS s_ref
        ON me_ref.entry_id = s_ref.entry_id
    WHERE me_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
      AND s_ref.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
      AND s_ref.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND s_ref.lattice_a <> 0
    LIMIT 1
) AS ni3al
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lattice_mismatch_percent ASC;

question: L1₂化合物で安定性と格子定数の両面でNi3Alに近い候補を出して。
sql:
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a
  FROM material_entry AS me
  JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE (
      me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      OR me.formula ILIKE '%Ni3Al%'
      OR me.formula ILIKE '%AlNi3%'
    )
    AND (
      s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1%2%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    )
    AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
    AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  me.entry_id AS material_id,
  me.reduced_formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant_a,
  ABS(ps.energy_above_hull - ref.energy_above_hull) AS stability_diff,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - ref.lattice_a) AS lattice_constant_diff
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ref
WHERE (
    s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1%2%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
  )
  AND NOT (
    me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    OR me.formula ILIKE '%Ni3Al%'
    OR me.formula ILIKE '%AlNi3%'
  )
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  ABS(ps.energy_above_hull - ref.energy_above_hull) ASC,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - ref.lattice_a) ASC
LIMIT 20;

question: Aサイト元素がNiまたはCoで、Bサイト元素がAlまたはTiのL1₂化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  me.*,
  s.*,
  c_a.element AS a_site_element,
  c_b.element AS b_site_element
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS c_a
  ON c_a.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS c_b
  ON c_b.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE (
    regexp_replace(
      lower(replace(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')),
      '[^a-z0-9]',
      '',
      'g'
    ) LIKE '%l12%'
    OR regexp_replace(
      lower(replace(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')),
      '[^a-z0-9]',
      '',
      'g'
    ) LIKE '%l12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    OR (
      s.space_group_number = 221
      AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'a3b'
    )
  )
  AND c_a.composition_id <> c_b.composition_id
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
  AND (
    (c_a.site_label ILIKE 'A%' AND c_b.site_label ILIKE 'B%')
    OR (
      c_a.atomic_fraction IS NOT NULL
      AND c_b.atomic_fraction IS NOT NULL
      AND c_a.atomic_fraction > c_b.atomic_fraction
    )
    OR me.reduced_formula ILIKE ('%' || c_a.element || '3%')
  )
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型金属間化合物において、相安定性、格子ミスマッチ、弾性特性を同時に考慮した析出強化相候補を抽出して。
sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT '1'::text AS matrix_entry_id
),
matrix AS (
    SELECT
        m.entry_id,
        s.lattice_a AS a_matrix,
        e.bulk_modulus_vrh AS k_matrix,
        e.shear_modulus_vrh AS g_matrix,
        e.youngs_modulus AS y_matrix
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor e ON e.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN params p ON p.matrix_entry_id = m.entry_id
),
elastic_constants AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cp.tensor_component = 'C11' THEN cp.value END) AS c11,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cp.tensor_component = 'C12' THEN cp.value END) AS c12,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cp.tensor_component = 'C44' THEN cp.value END) AS c44
    FROM calculation c
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
    WHERE cp.tensor_component IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT
    p.entry_id,
    p.formula AS formula_pretty,
    p.chemical_system,
    t.formation_energy_per_atom,
    t.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a AS a_l12,
    100.0 * (s.lattice_a - matrix.a_matrix) / matrix.a_matrix AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
    e.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    e.shear_modulus_vrh,
    e.youngs_modulus,
    e.poisson_ratio,
    ec.c11,
    ec.c12,
    ec.c44
FROM material_entry p
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = p.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability t ON t.entry_id = p.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor e ON e.entry_id = p.entry_id
JOIN elastic_constants ec ON ec.entry_id = p.entry_id
CROSS JOIN matrix
WHERE
    (
        s.strukturbericht = 'L1_2'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.space_group_number = 221
    )
    AND t.energy_above_hull <= 0.025
    AND t.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
    AND ABS(100.0 * (s.lattice_a - matrix.a_matrix) / matrix.a_matrix) <= 1.0
    AND ec.c11 - ec.c12 > 0
    AND ec.c11 + 2.0 * ec.c12 > 0
    AND ec.c44 > 0
    AND e.shear_modulus_vrh >= matrix.g_matrix
    AND e.youngs_modulus >= matrix.y_matrix
ORDER BY
    t.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ABS(100.0 * (s.lattice_a - matrix.a_matrix) / matrix.a_matrix) ASC,
    e.shear_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Al代替またはCo基γ'相候補として有望なL1₂型金属間化合物を、形成エネルギー、格子定数、弾性率の観点から探索して。
sql:
WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT
        m.entry_id AS material_id,
        m.formula AS formula,
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM composition c_co
                WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id
                  AND c_co.element = 'Co'
            ) THEN 'Co基γ''相候補'
            ELSE 'Ni3Al代替候補'
        END AS candidate_type,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant_a_angstrom,
        100.0 * (s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 3.57 AS lattice_mismatch_to_ni3al_pct,
        e.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
        e.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus_gpa,
        9.0 * e.bulk_modulus_vrh * e.shear_modulus_vrh
            / NULLIF(3.0 * e.bulk_modulus_vrh + e.shear_modulus_vrh, 0.0) AS youngs_modulus_gpa,
        (
            0.40 * LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0, -ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 0.60)) +
            0.25 * LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.15)) +
            0.20 * LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0, e.shear_modulus_vrh / 120.0)) +
            0.15 * LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0, e.bulk_modulus_vrh / 220.0))
        ) AS promise_score
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor e
        ON e.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        )
        AND m.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.05
        AND COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0) <= 0.05
        AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.50 AND 3.70
        AND e.bulk_modulus_vrh >= 120.0
        AND e.shear_modulus_vrh >= 60.0
)
SELECT
    material_id,
    formula,
    candidate_type,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    energy_above_hull,
    lattice_constant_a_angstrom,
    lattice_mismatch_to_ni3al_pct,
    bulk_modulus_gpa,
    shear_modulus_gpa,
    youngs_modulus_gpa,
    promise_score
FROM candidates
ORDER BY
    promise_score DESC,
    energy_above_hull ASC,
    formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    ABS(lattice_mismatch_to_ni3al_pct) ASC
LIMIT 50;

question: γ'相候補のランキングを安定性・格子整合性・バルクモジュラスの重み付きスコアで出して。
sql:
WITH lattice_properties AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    AVG(cp.value) AS lattice_mismatch_pct
  FROM calculation c
  JOIN calculated_property cp
    ON cp.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
  WHERE cp.property_name ILIKE 'lattice_mismatch_pct'
     OR cp.property_name ILIKE 'lattice_mismatch'
     OR cp.property_name ILIKE 'lattice mismatch%'
  GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
bulk_properties AS (
  SELECT
    entry_id,
    AVG(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_gpa
  FROM elastic_tensor
  WHERE bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entry_id
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id AS material_id,
    me.formula,
    mas.phase,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, s.prototype) AS structure_type,
    ps.energy_above_hull AS energy_above_hull_mev_atom,
    lp.lattice_mismatch_pct,
    bp.bulk_modulus_gpa
  FROM material_entry me
  LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
    ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN lattice_properties lp
    ON lp.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN bulk_properties bp
    ON bp.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE mas.phase = 'γ'''
     OR mas.phase ILIKE 'gamma_prime'
     OR s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
     OR s.prototype IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(
      (MAX(energy_above_hull_mev_atom) OVER () - energy_above_hull_mev_atom)
      / NULLIF(
          MAX(energy_above_hull_mev_atom) OVER () - MIN(energy_above_hull_mev_atom) OVER (),
          0
        ),
      1.0
    ) AS stability_score,
    COALESCE(
      (MAX(ABS(lattice_mismatch_pct)) OVER () - ABS(lattice_mismatch_pct))
      / NULLIF(
          MAX(ABS(lattice_mismatch_pct)) OVER () - MIN(ABS(lattice_mismatch_pct)) OVER (),
          0
        ),
      1.0
    ) AS lattice_match_score,
    COALESCE(
      (bulk_modulus_gpa - MIN(bulk_modulus_gpa) OVER ())
      / NULLIF(
          MAX(bulk_modulus_gpa) OVER () - MIN(bulk_modulus_gpa) OVER (),
          0
        ),
      1.0
    ) AS bulk_modulus_score
  FROM candidates
  WHERE energy_above_hull_mev_atom IS NOT NULL
    AND lattice_mismatch_pct IS NOT NULL
    AND bulk_modulus_gpa IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    0.5 * stability_score
    + 0.3 * lattice_match_score
    + 0.2 * bulk_modulus_score AS weighted_score
  FROM normalized
)
SELECT
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY weighted_score DESC) AS rank,
  material_id,
  formula,
  phase,
  structure_type,
  energy_above_hull_mev_atom,
  lattice_mismatch_pct,
  bulk_modulus_gpa,
  stability_score,
  lattice_match_score,
  bulk_modulus_score,
  weighted_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC, energy_above_hull_mev_atom ASC, ABS(lattice_mismatch_pct) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: NiまたはCo含有で安定かつバルクモジュラスが高いL1₂化合物トップ10を出して。

question: L1₂型化合物の元素組み合わせと安定性の関係をAサイト・Bサイト別に集計して材料設計の指針を得たい。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
  SELECT
    s.entry_id,
    BOOL_OR(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE '%AB3%') AS looks_ab3,
    BOOL_OR(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE '%A3B%') AS looks_a3b
  FROM structure s
  WHERE
    COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR (
      s.space_group_number = 221
      AND (
        COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE '%A3B%'
        OR COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE '%AB3%'
      )
    )
  GROUP BY s.entry_id
),
labeled_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    le.entry_id,
    c_a.element AS a_site_element,
    c_b.element AS b_site_element
  FROM l12_entries le
  JOIN composition c_a
    ON c_a.entry_id = le.entry_id
   AND c_a.site_label ILIKE 'A%'
  JOIN composition c_b
    ON c_b.entry_id = le.entry_id
   AND c_b.site_label ILIKE 'B%'
  WHERE c_a.element <> c_b.element
),
inferred_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    le.entry_id,
    CASE
      WHEN le.looks_ab3 AND NOT le.looks_a3b THEN c_minor.element
      ELSE c_major.element
    END AS a_site_element,
    CASE
      WHEN le.looks_ab3 AND NOT le.looks_a3b THEN c_major.element
      ELSE c_minor.element
    END AS b_site_element
  FROM l12_entries le
  JOIN composition c_major
    ON c_major.entry_id = le.entry_id
  JOIN composition c_minor
    ON c_minor.entry_id = le.entry_id
  WHERE c_major.element <> c_minor.element
    AND c_major.atomic_fraction IS NOT NULL
    AND c_minor.atomic_fraction IS NOT NULL
    AND c_major.atomic_fraction > c_minor.atomic_fraction
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM labeled_pairs lp
      WHERE lp.entry_id = le.entry_id
    )
),
site_pairs AS (
  SELECT * FROM labeled_pairs
  UNION
  SELECT * FROM inferred_pairs
)
SELECT
  sp.a_site_element,
  sp.b_site_element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS compound_count,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
  MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS min_formation_energy_per_atom,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) AS min_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  ) AS stable_or_near_stable_count,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
    )::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    3
  ) AS stable_or_near_stable_ratio
FROM site_pairs sp
JOIN material_entry me
  ON me.entry_id = sp.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
GROUP BY
  sp.a_site_element,
  sp.b_site_element
ORDER BY
  stable_or_near_stable_ratio DESC,
  avg_energy_above_hull ASC,
  compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni3Alの格子定数に近く、バルクモジュラスが高く、安定なL1₂候補を総合的にランキングして。
sql:
WITH ni3al AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id AS ni3al_id,
        s.lattice_a AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
      ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
      ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
          s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
          OR s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id AS material_id,
        me.formula,
        s.lattice_a,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - n.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_delta,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - n.ni3al_lattice_a) / n.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_delta_ratio,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus,
        ps.energy_above_hull
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
      ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
      ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
      ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al n
    WHERE (
          s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
          OR s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      )
      AND me.entry_id <> n.ni3al_id
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
      AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
      AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        0.45 * EXP(-c.lattice_delta_ratio / 0.01)
      + 0.35 * (c.bulk_modulus / NULLIF(MAX(c.bulk_modulus) OVER (), 0))
      + 0.20 * GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - c.energy_above_hull / 0.05) AS total_score
    FROM candidates c
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_score DESC) AS rank,
    material_id,
    formula,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_delta,
    lattice_delta_ratio,
    bulk_modulus,
    energy_above_hull,
    total_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY total_score DESC, lattice_delta ASC, bulk_modulus DESC;

question: 析出強化に適したL1₂化合物を格子ミスマッチ、弾性率、安定性の多基準で評価して上位候補を出して。
sql:
WITH structure_rows AS (
  SELECT
    me.entry_id AS compound_id,
    me.formula,
    mas.alloy_system_id,
    mas.phase,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.lattice_a,
    (
      lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) IN ('l12', 'l1_2', 'l1 2', 'cu3au')
      OR lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%l12%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%l1_2%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%cu3au%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')) IN ('l12', 'l1_2', 'l1 2')
      OR lower(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')) LIKE '%l12%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')) LIKE '%l1_2%'
      OR (
        s.space_group_number = 221
        AND upper(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')) IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
      )
    ) AS is_l12,
    (
      lower(COALESCE(mas.phase, '')) LIKE '%matrix%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(mas.phase, '')) = 'gamma'
      OR lower(COALESCE(mas.phase, '')) = 'γ'
      OR lower(COALESCE(mas.phase, '')) LIKE '%fcc%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')) = 'A1'
      OR lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) IN ('fcc', 'a1')
      OR lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%fcc%'
      OR (
        s.space_group_number = 225
        AND me.number_of_elements = 1
      )
    ) AS is_matrix_like
  FROM material_entry me
  JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  JOIN material_alloy_system mas
    ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
),
with_matrix AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    MAX(lattice_a) FILTER (
      WHERE is_matrix_like AND NOT is_l12
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY alloy_system_id) AS explicit_a_matrix,
    AVG(lattice_a) FILTER (
      WHERE NOT is_l12
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY alloy_system_id) AS fallback_a_matrix
  FROM structure_rows
),
elastic_props AS (
  SELECT
    entry_id,
    MAX(youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus,
    MAX(shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus_vrh,
    MAX(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh
  FROM elastic_tensor
  GROUP BY entry_id
),
stability_props AS (
  SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
    MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
    MIN(pde.hull_distance) AS hull_distance,
    BOOL_OR(COALESCE(ps.is_stable, FALSE)) AS is_stable,
    BOOL_OR(COALESCE(pde.is_on_hull, FALSE)) AS is_on_hull
  FROM material_entry me
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde
    ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
  GROUP BY me.entry_id
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (wm.compound_id)
    wm.compound_id,
    wm.formula,
    wm.prototype,
    wm.strukturbericht,
    wm.lattice_a AS a_l12,
    COALESCE(wm.explicit_a_matrix, wm.fallback_a_matrix, wm.lattice_a) AS a_matrix,
    ABS(wm.lattice_a - COALESCE(wm.explicit_a_matrix, wm.fallback_a_matrix, wm.lattice_a))
      / NULLIF(COALESCE(wm.explicit_a_matrix, wm.fallback_a_matrix, wm.lattice_a), 0)
      * 100.0 AS lattice_mismatch_pct,
    COALESCE(
      ep.youngs_modulus,
      2.6 * ep.shear_modulus_vrh,
      1.5 * ep.bulk_modulus_vrh
    ) AS youngs_modulus_gpa,
    ep.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus_gpa,
    COALESCE(
      sp.energy_above_hull,
      sp.hull_distance,
      CASE
        WHEN sp.is_stable OR sp.is_on_hull THEN 0.0
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    sp.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
  FROM with_matrix wm
  LEFT JOIN elastic_props ep
    ON ep.entry_id = wm.compound_id
  LEFT JOIN stability_props sp
    ON sp.entry_id = wm.compound_id
  WHERE wm.is_l12
    AND COALESCE(wm.explicit_a_matrix, wm.fallback_a_matrix, wm.lattice_a) IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(wm.explicit_a_matrix, wm.fallback_a_matrix, wm.lattice_a) <> 0
  ORDER BY
    wm.compound_id,
    ABS(wm.lattice_a - COALESCE(wm.explicit_a_matrix, wm.fallback_a_matrix, wm.lattice_a))
      / NULLIF(COALESCE(wm.explicit_a_matrix, wm.fallback_a_matrix, wm.lattice_a), 0) ASC
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    1.0 - PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY lattice_mismatch_pct ASC NULLS LAST
    ) AS mismatch_score,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY youngs_modulus_gpa ASC NULLS FIRST
    ) AS modulus_score,
    1.0 - PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
    ) AS stability_score
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT
  compound_id,
  formula,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht,
  a_l12,
  a_matrix,
  lattice_mismatch_pct,
  youngs_modulus_gpa,
  shear_modulus_gpa,
  energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
  formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  ROUND(
    (
      0.40 * COALESCE(mismatch_score, 0.0) +
      0.30 * COALESCE(modulus_score, 0.0) +
      0.30 * COALESCE(stability_score, 0.0)
    )::numeric,
    4
  ) AS precipitation_strengthening_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY precipitation_strengthening_score DESC,
         lattice_mismatch_pct ASC NULLS LAST,
         energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

question: Co基超合金のγ'相候補として、Co含有で安定なL1₂化合物をNi3Alとの比較で評価して。
L1₂型化合物データベースから、バルクモジュラスとせん断弾性率の比(B/G比)を計算して延性候補を抽出して。
sql:
SELECT
  me.entry_id AS compound_id,
  me.formula,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
  et.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus_gpa,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh::numeric / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh::numeric, 0) AS b_g_ratio
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON me.entry_id = et.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')

  AND et.shear_modulus_vrh <> 0
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh::numeric / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh::numeric, 0) >= 1.75

LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物の安定性マップ（formation energy vs energy above hull）を出力して、候補を4象限に分類して。
sql:
WITH normalized_structure AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.entry_id,
    s.space_group_number,
    regexp_replace(
      lower(translate(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
      '[^a-z0-9]',
      '',
      'g'
    ) AS prototype_norm,
    regexp_replace(
      lower(translate(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
      '[^a-z0-9]',
      '',
      'g'
    ) AS strukturbericht_norm,
    regexp_replace(
      lower(translate(coalesce(s.formula_type, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
      '[^a-z0-9]',
      '',
      'g'
    ) AS formula_type_norm
  FROM structure AS s
),
l12_entries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT entry_id
  FROM normalized_structure
  WHERE prototype_norm LIKE '%l12%'
     OR strukturbericht_norm LIKE '%l12%'
     OR prototype_norm LIKE '%cu3au%'
     OR strukturbericht_norm LIKE '%cu3au%'
     OR prototype_norm LIKE '%aucu3%'
     OR strukturbericht_norm LIKE '%aucu3%'
     OR (
          space_group_number = 221
          AND formula_type_norm IN ('a3b', 'ab3')
        )
)
SELECT
  me.entry_id AS material_id,
  me.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
     AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
      THEN 'Q1: stable candidate (low formation energy, near hull)'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
     AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05
      THEN 'Q2: metastable candidate (low formation energy, above hull)'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0
     AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
      THEN 'Q3: near hull but positive formation energy'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0
     AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05
      THEN 'Q4: unstable candidate'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN l12_entries AS l12
  ON me.entry_id = l12.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 高温安定性の観点で有望なL1₂型化合物を形成エネルギーの深さで評価して上位を出して。
sql:
SELECT
  me.source_material_id AS material_id,
  me.formula AS formula,
  s.prototype,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  -ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_depth_ev_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
WHERE

    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'

    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
  )
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
  AND (
    ps.energy_above_hull IS NULL
    OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  )

  energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

question: Ni基超合金のγ'相代替候補として、Ni-Al系以外で安定なL1₂化合物を格子整合性で評価して。
sql:
WITH gamma_prime AS (
  SELECT s.lattice_a AS a0
  FROM material_entry AS me
  JOIN structure AS s
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
  JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
  WHERE me.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al'
    AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
    AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
),
composition_elements AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(c.element ORDER BY c.element) AS elements
  FROM composition AS c
  GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT
  me.entry_id AS material_id,
  me.reduced_formula AS formula_pretty,
  ce.elements,
  s.space_group AS spacegroup_symbol,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a AS lattice_parameter_a,
  ROUND(((s.lattice_a - gp.a0) / gp.a0 * 100.0)::numeric, 3) AS lattice_mismatch_percent
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN composition_elements AS ce
  ON me.entry_id = ce.entry_id
CROSS JOIN gamma_prime AS gp
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.025
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition AS cni
      WHERE cni.entry_id = me.entry_id
        AND cni.element = 'Ni'
    )

question: 元素周期の観点から、3d遷移金属と4d/5d遷移金属をAサイトに持つL1₂化合物の安定性傾向を比較して。
sql:
WITH structure_norm AS (
  SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.number_of_elements,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group,
    regexp_replace(
      upper(translate(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
      '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
    ) AS strukturbericht_norm,
    regexp_replace(
      upper(translate(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
      '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
    ) AS prototype_norm,
    regexp_replace(
      upper(translate(COALESCE(s.formula_type, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
      '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
    ) AS formula_type_norm
  FROM material_entry me
  JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
),
l12_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sn.entry_id,
    sn.formation_energy_per_atom,
    sn.energy_above_hull,
    sn.formula_type_norm
  FROM structure_norm sn
  WHERE
    sn.strukturbericht_norm LIKE '%L12%'
    OR sn.prototype_norm LIKE '%L12%'
    OR sn.prototype_norm LIKE '%CU3AU%'
    OR sn.prototype_norm LIKE '%AUCU3%'
    OR sn.formula_type_norm LIKE '%AB3%'
    OR sn.formula_type_norm LIKE '%A3B%'
    OR (
      sn.number_of_elements = 2
      AND (
        sn.space_group_number = 221
        OR regexp_replace(upper(COALESCE(sn.space_group, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%PM3M%'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition c1
        WHERE c1.entry_id = sn.entry_id
          AND (
            c1.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
            OR c1.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 20 AND 30
          )
      )
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition c2
        WHERE c2.entry_id = sn.entry_id
          AND (
            c2.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
            OR c2.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 70 AND 80
          )
      )
    )
),
a_site AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l.entry_id,
    c.element AS a_element,
    l.formation_energy_per_atom,
    l.energy_above_hull
  FROM l12_candidates l
  JOIN composition c
    ON c.entry_id = l.entry_id
  WHERE
    regexp_replace(upper(COALESCE(c.site_label, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') ~ '(^A|ASITE|SITEA)'
    OR (
      COALESCE(c.site_label, '') = ''
      AND (
        (
          l.formula_type_norm LIKE '%A3B%'
          AND (
            c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
            OR c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 70 AND 80
          )
        )
        OR (
          l.formula_type_norm NOT LIKE '%A3B%'
          AND (
            c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
            OR c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 20 AND 30
          )
        )
      )
    )
),
classified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    a.entry_id,
    CASE
      WHEN e.period_number = 4 THEN '3d transition metal on A-site'
      WHEN e.period_number IN (5, 6) THEN '4d/5d transition metal on A-site'
    END AS a_site_period_class,
    a.formation_energy_per_atom,
    a.energy_above_hull
  FROM a_site a
  JOIN element e
    ON e.symbol = a.a_element
  WHERE e.group_number BETWEEN 3 AND 12
    AND e.period_number IN (4, 5, 6)
)
SELECT
  a_site_period_class,
  COUNT(*) AS n_compounds,
  AVG(formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
  AVG(energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY energy_above_hull) AS median_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE energy_above_hull <= 0.025) AS n_stable_or_near_stable,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE energy_above_hull <= 0.025)::double precision
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS stable_or_near_stable_fraction
FROM classified
GROUP BY a_site_period_class
ORDER BY a_site_period_class
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂化合物のうちNi3Alより安定でバルクモジュラスが高い候補を出して。
sql:
WITH ref AS (
    SELECT
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS ref_formation_energy_per_atom,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS ref_bulk_modulus
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
        ON me.entry_id = et.entry_id
    WHERE me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
          s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
          OR s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      )
    ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id AS material_id,
    me.reduced_formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON me.entry_id = et.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ref
WHERE (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  )
  AND me.reduced_formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < ref.ref_formation_energy_per_atom
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh > ref.ref_bulk_modulus
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC;

question: Co-Al-W系L1₂候補の安定性と弾性特性を評価して。
sql:
WITH co_al_w_related AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id
  FROM composition AS c
  GROUP BY c.entry_id
  HAVING
    BOOL_AND(c.element IN ('Co', 'Al', 'W'))
    AND BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Co')
    AND BOOL_OR(c.element IN ('Al', 'W'))
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) BETWEEN 2 AND 3
),
l12_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    s.entry_id
  FROM structure AS s
  WHERE
    s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu%Au%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
    OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
    OR (
      s.space_group_number = 221
      AND (
        s.prototype IS NULL
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%cubic%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%perovskite%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Au%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%'
      )
    )
),
elastic_props AS (
  SELECT
    et.entry_id,
    MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh,
    MAX(et.shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus_vrh,
    MAX(et.youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus,
    MAX(et.poisson_ratio) AS poisson_ratio,
    MAX(cp.value) FILTER (
      WHERE cp.property_name ILIKE '%anisotrop%'
    ) AS elastic_anisotropy,
    MAX(cp.value) FILTER (
      WHERE cp.tensor_component ~* '^c_?11$'
    ) AS c11,
    MAX(cp.value) FILTER (
      WHERE cp.tensor_component ~* '^c_?12$'
    ) AS c12,
    MAX(cp.value) FILTER (
      WHERE cp.tensor_component ~* '^c_?44$'
    ) AS c44
  FROM elastic_tensor AS et
  LEFT JOIN calculation AS calc
    ON calc.calculation_id = et.calculation_id
  LEFT JOIN calculated_property AS cp
    ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  GROUP BY et.entry_id
)
SELECT
  me.entry_id AS material_id,
  me.formula AS formula_pretty,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system,
  s.space_group AS spacegroup_symbol,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.formula_type,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.0001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability,
  ep.bulk_modulus_vrh,
  ep.shear_modulus_vrh,
  ep.youngs_modulus,
  ep.poisson_ratio,
  ep.elastic_anisotropy,
  ep.c11,
  ep.c12,
  ep.c44
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN co_al_w_related AS cawr
  ON cawr.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN l12_candidates AS l12
  ON l12.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN elastic_props AS ep
  ON ep.entry_id = me.entry_id
ORDER BY
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST,
  me.entry_id ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 全L1₂化合物について、安定性スコア×格子整合性スコア×弾性スコアの複合スコアを計算してランキングして。
sql:
WITH scores AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    MAX(cp.value) FILTER (
      WHERE LOWER(cp.property_name) LIKE '%stability%'
    ) AS stability_score,
    MAX(cp.value) FILTER (
      WHERE LOWER(cp.property_name) LIKE '%lattice%match%'
         OR LOWER(cp.property_name) LIKE '%lattice_matching%'
    ) AS lattice_matching_score,
    MAX(cp.value) FILTER (
      WHERE LOWER(cp.property_name) LIKE '%elastic%'
    ) AS elastic_score
  FROM calculation c
  JOIN calculated_property cp
    ON cp.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
  WHERE LOWER(cp.property_name) LIKE '%stability%'
     OR LOWER(cp.property_name) LIKE '%lattice%match%'
     OR LOWER(cp.property_name) LIKE '%lattice_matching%'
     OR LOWER(cp.property_name) LIKE '%elastic%'
  GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
l12_entries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.entry_id
  FROM structure s
  WHERE LOWER(
          REPLACE(
            REPLACE(
              REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''),
              '₂', '2'
            ),
            '-', ''
          )
        ) IN ('l12', 'l1_2')
     OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%cu3au%'
     OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%l12%'
     OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%l1_2%'
)
SELECT
  me.entry_id AS compound_id,
  me.formula,
  sc.stability_score,
  sc.lattice_matching_score,
  sc.elastic_score,
  sc.stability_score * sc.lattice_matching_score * sc.elastic_score AS composite_score,
  RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY sc.stability_score * sc.lattice_matching_score * sc.elastic_score DESC
  ) AS composite_rank
FROM material_entry me
JOIN l12_entries le
  ON le.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN scores sc
  ON sc.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE sc.stability_score IS NOT NULL
  AND sc.lattice_matching_score IS NOT NULL
  AND sc.elastic_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY composite_rank, me.formula
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni3Al代替γ'相候補をバルクモジュラス、形成エネルギー、格子ミスマッチの3軸パレート面で出力して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ref_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id AS material_id,
        me.formula AS formula,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
        100.0 * (s.lattice_a - nr.ref_lattice_a) / nr.ref_lattice_a AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
        ABS(100.0 * (s.lattice_a - nr.ref_lattice_a) / nr.ref_lattice_a) AS abs_lattice_mismatch_percent
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref AS nr
    WHERE
        nr.ref_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM material_alloy_system AS mas
                WHERE
                    mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
                    AND LOWER(mas.phase) LIKE '%gamma%prime%'
            )
            OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) IN ('l12', 'l1_2', 'cu3au')
            OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')) IN ('l12', 'l1_2')
            OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')) IN ('a3b', 'ab3')
        )
        AND me.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
        AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    c.material_id,
    c.formula,
    c.bulk_modulus_gpa,
    c.formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    c.lattice_mismatch_percent
FROM candidates AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM candidates AS d
    WHERE
        d.material_id <> c.material_id
        AND d.bulk_modulus_gpa >= c.bulk_modulus_gpa
        AND d.formation_energy_ev_per_atom <= c.formation_energy_ev_per_atom
        AND d.abs_lattice_mismatch_percent <= c.abs_lattice_mismatch_percent
        AND (
            d.bulk_modulus_gpa > c.bulk_modulus_gpa
            OR d.formation_energy_ev_per_atom < c.formation_energy_ev_per_atom
            OR d.abs_lattice_mismatch_percent < c.abs_lattice_mismatch_percent
        )
)
ORDER BY
    c.formation_energy_ev_per_atom ASC,
    c.abs_lattice_mismatch_percent ASC,
    c.bulk_modulus_gpa DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物データベースから材料設計仮説を導出するため、安定化合物の元素分布とその物性傾向を包括的に集計して。
次世代γ'相候補として、Ni-Al-Co-Ti四元系でL1₂構造をとりうる組成を探索して。
sql:
WITH elem_frac AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.element,
    SUM(c.atomic_fraction) AS atomic_fraction
  FROM composition c
  WHERE c.element IN ('Ni', 'Al', 'Co', 'Ti')
  GROUP BY c.entry_id, c.element
),
comp_summary AS (
  SELECT
    ef.entry_id,
    string_agg(
      ef.element || ':' || ef.atomic_fraction::text,
      ', ' ORDER BY ef.element
    ) AS composition,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ef.element) AS num_distinct_elements,
    BOOL_OR(ef.element = 'Ni') AS has_ni,
    BOOL_OR(ef.element = 'Al') AS has_al,
    BOOL_OR(ef.element = 'Co') AS has_co,
    BOOL_OR(ef.element = 'Ti') AS has_ti,
    COALESCE(SUM(ef.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE ef.element = 'Ni'), 0) AS ni_fraction,
    COALESCE(SUM(ef.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE ef.element = 'Al'), 0) AS al_fraction,
    COALESCE(SUM(ef.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE ef.element = 'Co'), 0) AS co_fraction,
    COALESCE(SUM(ef.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE ef.element = 'Ti'), 0) AS ti_fraction
  FROM elem_frac ef
  GROUP BY ef.entry_id
),
all_elements AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) AS total_num_elements,
    BOOL_AND(c.element IN ('Ni', 'Al', 'Co', 'Ti')) AS only_requested_elements
  FROM composition c
  GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT
  me.entry_id AS material_id,
  me.formula AS formula_pretty,
  cs.composition,
  cs.ni_fraction,
  cs.al_fraction,
  cs.co_fraction,
  cs.ti_fraction,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.formula_type,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry me
JOIN comp_summary cs
  ON cs.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN all_elements ae
  ON ae.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE ae.only_requested_elements
  AND ae.total_num_elements BETWEEN 2 AND 4
  AND cs.has_ni
  AND cs.has_al
  AND (
    COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ~* '(L1[_ -]?2|L12|Cu3Au|AuCu3)'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ~* '(L1[_ -]?2|L12|Cu3Au|AuCu3)'
    OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR (
      s.space_group_number = 221
      AND (
        COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE '%A3B%'
        OR COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE '%AB3%'
        OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
      )
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN cs.has_co AND cs.has_ti THEN 0
    WHEN cs.has_co OR cs.has_ti THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END,
  ae.total_num_elements DESC,
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

question: 形成エネルギーが負のL1₂型化合物を元素組み合わせごとに整理して。
sql:
WITH entry_elements AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        string_agg(DISTINCT c.element, '-' ORDER BY c.element) AS element_combination
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
l12_negative AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
      AND (
          replace(replace(upper(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '')), '_', ''), '₂', '2') = 'L12'
          OR replace(replace(upper(coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '_', ''), '₂', '2') = 'L12'
      )
)
SELECT
    ee.element_combination,
    count(*) AS compound_count,
    jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'entry_id', ln.entry_id,
            'formula', ln.formula,
            'reduced_formula', ln.reduced_formula,
            'chemical_system', ln.chemical_system,
            'prototype', ln.prototype,
            'strukturbericht', ln.strukturbericht,
            'space_group_number', ln.space_group_number,
            'formation_energy_per_atom', ln.formation_energy_per_atom,
            'energy_above_hull', ln.energy_above_hull,
            'is_stable', ln.is_stable
        )
        ORDER BY ln.formation_energy_per_atom, ln.reduced_formula
    ) AS compounds
FROM l12_negative ln
JOIN entry_elements ee
    ON ee.entry_id = ln.entry_id
GROUP BY ee.element_combination
ORDER BY ee.element_combination
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Alに近い格子定数を持つL1₂化合物を探して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      )
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.lattice_a,
    r.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    100.0 * ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_a_difference_percent,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND me.reduced_formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY lattice_a_difference ASC
LIMIT 50;

question: L1₂型化合物の形成エネルギー分布を教えて。
sql:
SELECT
  (floor(ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 0.10) * 0.10)::numeric(10, 2) AS formation_energy_bin_start_ev_per_atom,
  ((floor(ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 0.10) + 1) * 0.10)::numeric(10, 2) AS formation_energy_bin_end_ev_per_atom,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS compound_count,
  MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS min_formation_energy_per_atom,
  MAX(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS max_formation_energy_per_atom,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND me.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
GROUP BY floor(ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 0.10)
ORDER BY formation_energy_bin_start_ev_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

    cb.element AS b_site_element,

    AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
    MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS min_formation_energy_per_atom,
    MAX(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS max_formation_energy_per_atom,
    STDDEV_SAMP(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS stddev_formation_energy_per_atom,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT me.reduced_formula ORDER BY me.reduced_formula) AS example_formulas
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition ca
    ON ca.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND ca.site_label ILIKE 'A%'
JOIN composition cb
    ON cb.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND cb.site_label ILIKE 'B%'
WHERE
    (
        UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.strukturbericht, '₂', '2'), '-', '_')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    )
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
    AND ca.element <> cb.element
GROUP BY
    ca.element,
    cb.element
ORDER BY

question: L1₂構造を持つ化合物のうち、格子定数がNi₃Alに近く、形成エネルギーが低い候補を抽出して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
          s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1%2'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%2%'
          OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%L1%2%'
      )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.lattice_a,
    r.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    100.0 * ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_a_difference_percent,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
WHERE (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1%2'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%2%'
        OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%L1%2%'
      )
  AND me.reduced_formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND r.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a <= 0.02
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    lattice_a_difference ASC
LIMIT 50;

question: Aサイト元素別にL1₂型化合物の平均格子定数を集計して。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
  SELECT
    s.entry_id,
    AVG(s.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
    MAX(s.formula_type) AS formula_type
  FROM structure AS s
  JOIN material_entry AS me
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
  WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '₂', '2') LIKE '%l12%'
      OR REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '₂', '2') LIKE '%l12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
      OR (
        s.space_group_number = 221
        AND (
          REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')), ' ', '') LIKE '%A3B%'
          OR REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')), ' ', '') LIKE '%AB3%'
        )
      )
    )
  GROUP BY s.entry_id
),
composition_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.element,
    c.site_label,
    c.atomic_fraction,
    le.formula_type,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.site_label ILIKE 'A%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY c.entry_id) AS has_a_site_label,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.entry_id
      ORDER BY c.atomic_fraction DESC NULLS LAST, c.element
    ) AS frac_desc_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.entry_id
      ORDER BY c.atomic_fraction ASC NULLS LAST, c.element
    ) AS frac_asc_rank
  FROM l12_entries AS le
  JOIN material_entry AS me
    ON me.entry_id = le.entry_id
  JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
)
SELECT
  cr.element AS a_site_element,
  AVG(le.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_constant,
  COUNT(DISTINCT le.entry_id) AS num_compounds
FROM l12_entries AS le
JOIN composition_ranked AS cr
  ON cr.entry_id = le.entry_id
WHERE
  (
    cr.has_a_site_label = 1
    AND cr.site_label ILIKE 'A%'
  )
  OR (
    cr.has_a_site_label = 0
    AND REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(cr.formula_type, '')), ' ', '') LIKE '%AB3%'
    AND cr.frac_asc_rank = 1
  )
  OR (
    cr.has_a_site_label = 0
    AND REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(cr.formula_type, '')), ' ', '') NOT LIKE '%AB3%'
    AND cr.frac_desc_rank = 1
  )
GROUP BY cr.element
ORDER BY cr.element
LIMIT 10000;

question: Co3TiとNi3Alの格子定数差を計算して。
sql:
WITH element_fracs AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        element,
        SUM(atomic_fraction) AS frac
    FROM composition
    GROUP BY entry_id, element
    HAVING SUM(atomic_fraction) > 0
),
classified_entries AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) = 2
             AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element IN ('Co', 'Ti')) = 2
             AND MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'Co' THEN frac END) BETWEEN 0.749 AND 0.751
             AND MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'Ti' THEN frac END) BETWEEN 0.249 AND 0.251
                THEN 'Co3Ti'
            WHEN COUNT(*) = 2
             AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element IN ('Ni', 'Al')) = 2
             AND MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'Ni' THEN frac END) BETWEEN 0.749 AND 0.751
             AND MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'Al' THEN frac END) BETWEEN 0.249 AND 0.251
                THEN 'Ni3Al'
        END AS target_formula
    FROM element_fracs
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
lattice AS (
    SELECT
        ce.target_formula,
        s.lattice_a,
        s.lattice_b,
        s.lattice_c
    FROM classified_entries ce
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = ce.entry_id
    WHERE ce.target_formula IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    AVG(lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Co3Ti') AS co3ti_lattice_a,
    AVG(lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Ni3Al') AS ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(
        AVG(lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Co3Ti')
        - AVG(lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Ni3Al')
    ) AS lattice_a_difference,
    AVG(lattice_b) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Co3Ti') AS co3ti_lattice_b,
    AVG(lattice_b) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Ni3Al') AS ni3al_lattice_b,
    ABS(
        AVG(lattice_b) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Co3Ti')
        - AVG(lattice_b) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Ni3Al')
    ) AS lattice_b_difference,
    AVG(lattice_c) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Co3Ti') AS co3ti_lattice_c,
    AVG(lattice_c) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Ni3Al') AS ni3al_lattice_c,
    ABS(
        AVG(lattice_c) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Co3Ti')
        - AVG(lattice_c) FILTER (WHERE target_formula = 'Ni3Al')
    ) AS lattice_c_difference
FROM lattice
LIMIT 10000;

question: Bサイト元素ごとの安定L1₂化合物数を集計して。
sql:
WITH stable_l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            ps.is_stable = TRUE
            OR COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 1.0) <= 1e-6
        )
        AND (
            REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') IN ('l12', 'l1₂')
            OR REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') LIKE '%l12%'
            OR REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') LIKE '%l1₂%'
            OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%cu3au%'
            OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%aucu3%'
            OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
                AND (
                    LOWER(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')) LIKE '%a3b%'
                    OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')) LIKE '%ab3%'
                )
            )
        )
),
b_site_elements AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        c.element
    FROM composition AS c
    JOIN stable_l12_entries AS sle
        ON sle.entry_id = c.entry_id
    WHERE c.site_label ILIKE '%B%'

    UNION

    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        c.element
    FROM composition AS c
    JOIN stable_l12_entries AS sle
        ON sle.entry_id = c.entry_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition AS cb
        WHERE cb.entry_id = c.entry_id
          AND cb.site_label ILIKE '%B%'
    )
      AND c.atomic_fraction = (
          SELECT MIN(cmin.atomic_fraction)
          FROM composition AS cmin
          WHERE cmin.entry_id = c.entry_id
      )
)
SELECT
    bse.element AS b_site_element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bse.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM b_site_elements AS bse
GROUP BY bse.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC, b_site_element
LIMIT 10000;

    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    c.functional,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS c
    ON c.calculation_id = et.calculation_id
WHERE c.functional ILIKE '%PBE%'
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂化合物の格子ミスマッチ（Ni3Alとの差）を計算して小さい順に表示して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al'
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      )
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.lattice_a,
    r.ni3al_lattice_a,
    s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_difference_from_ni3al,
    ABS((s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a) * 100.0 AS lattice_mismatch_percent
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND r.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
  )
ORDER BY lattice_mismatch_percent ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂化合物で安定性と格子定数の両面でNi3Alに近い候補を出して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        s.lattice_a AS ref_lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull AS ref_energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS ref_formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition c_ni
        ON c_ni.entry_id = me.entry_id
       AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
    JOIN composition c_al
        ON c_al.entry_id = me.entry_id
       AND c_al.element = 'Al'
    WHERE me.number_of_elements = 2
      AND ABS(c_ni.atomic_fraction - 0.75) < 0.02
      AND ABS(c_al.atomic_fraction - 0.25) < 0.02
      AND (
          s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE (
          s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.formula,
    c.reduced_formula,
    c.chemical_system,
    c.prototype,
    c.strukturbericht,
    c.space_group_number,
    c.lattice_a,
    r.ref_lattice_a AS ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(c.lattice_a - r.ref_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    c.energy_above_hull,
    r.ref_energy_above_hull AS ni3al_energy_above_hull,
    ABS(c.energy_above_hull - r.ref_energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_difference,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom,
    r.ref_formation_energy_per_atom AS ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom,
    ABS(c.formation_energy_per_atom - r.ref_formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_difference,
    c.is_stable,
    (
        POWER(ABS(c.lattice_a - r.ref_lattice_a) / NULLIF(r.ref_lattice_a, 0), 2)
        +
        POWER(ABS(c.energy_above_hull - r.ref_energy_above_hull) / 0.05, 2)
    ) AS similarity_score
FROM l12_candidates c
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
WHERE c.entry_id <> r.entry_id
ORDER BY similarity_score ASC, energy_above_hull_difference ASC, lattice_a_difference ASC
LIMIT 25;

question: Aサイト元素がNiまたはCoで、Bサイト元素がAlまたはTiのL1₂化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    ca.element AS a_site_element,
    cb.element AS b_site_element,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS ca
    ON ca.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS cb
    ON cb.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE ca.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND cb.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
  AND ca.element <> cb.element
  AND ca.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
  AND cb.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
  AND (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        OR (
             s.space_group_number = 221
             AND (
                  s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
                  OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
             )
        )
      )
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物の体積あたり原子数と格子定数の関係を出して。

question: 遷移金属を含むL1₂型化合物のうち安定なものを出して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    string_agg(DISTINCT c_tm.element, ', ' ORDER BY c_tm.element) AS transition_metals

JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS c_tm

  AND c_tm.element IN (
        'Sc','Ti','V','Cr','Mn','Fe','Co','Ni','Cu','Zn',
        'Y','Zr','Nb','Mo','Tc','Ru','Rh','Pd','Ag','Cd',
        'Hf','Ta','W','Re','Os','Ir','Pt','Au','Hg',
        'Rf','Db','Sg','Bh','Hs','Mt','Ds','Rg','Cn'
      )
  AND (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
        OR (
            s.space_group_number = 221
            AND upper(replace(coalesce(s.formula_type, ''), ' ', '')) IN ('AB3', 'A3B')

    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
