question: L1₂型金属間化合物において、相安定性、格子ミスマッチ、弾性特性を同時に考慮した析出強化相候補を抽出して。
sql:
WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.lattice_a,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable AS phase_is_stable,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.poisson_ratio,
        et.is_stable AS elastic_is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
        ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        )
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
        AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
        AND et.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
        AND et.youngs_modulus IS NOT NULL
        AND COALESCE(et.is_stable, TRUE) = TRUE
),
matrix_phases AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id AS matrix_entry_id,
        me.formula AS matrix_formula,
        me.reduced_formula AS matrix_reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        s.prototype AS matrix_prototype,
        s.strukturbericht AS matrix_strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number AS matrix_space_group_number,
        s.lattice_a AS matrix_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
        ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'A1'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%fcc%'
            OR s.space_group_number = 225
        )
)
SELECT
    c.entry_id AS precipitate_entry_id,
    c.formula AS precipitate_formula,
    c.reduced_formula AS precipitate_reduced_formula,
    c.chemical_system,
    c.prototype,
    c.strukturbericht,
    c.space_group_number,
    c.lattice_a AS precipitate_lattice_a,
    m.matrix_entry_id,
    m.matrix_formula,
    m.matrix_reduced_formula,
    m.matrix_prototype,
    m.matrix_strukturbericht,
    m.matrix_space_group_number,
    m.matrix_lattice_a,
    100.0 * ABS(c.lattice_a - m.matrix_lattice_a) / m.matrix_lattice_a AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom,
    c.energy_above_hull,
    c.phase_is_stable,
    c.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    c.shear_modulus_vrh,
    c.youngs_modulus,
    c.poisson_ratio,
    c.elastic_is_stable,
    c.youngs_modulus / NULLIF(c.bulk_modulus_vrh, 0) AS strengthening_modulus_ratio
FROM l12_candidates c
JOIN matrix_phases m
    ON (
        c.alloy_system_id IS NOT NULL
        AND m.alloy_system_id = c.alloy_system_id
    )
    OR (
        c.alloy_system_id IS NULL
        AND m.alloy_system_id IS NULL
        AND m.chemical_system = c.chemical_system
    )
WHERE
    c.entry_id <> m.matrix_entry_id
    AND c.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
    AND 100.0 * ABS(c.lattice_a - m.matrix_lattice_a) / m.matrix_lattice_a <= 2.0
    AND c.bulk_modulus_vrh >= 50.0
    AND c.shear_modulus_vrh >= 20.0
    AND c.youngs_modulus >= 50.0
ORDER BY
    c.energy_above_hull ASC,
    lattice_mismatch_percent ASC,
    c.shear_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Al代替またはCo基γ'相候補として有望なL1₂型金属間化合物を、形成エネルギー、格子定数、弾性率の観点から探索して。
sql:
WITH composition_summary AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        STRING_AGG(c.element, '-' ORDER BY c.element) AS elements,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) AS n_elements,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Co') AS has_co,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Ni') AS has_ni,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Al') AS has_al,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) AS max_atomic_fraction,
        MIN(c.atomic_fraction) AS min_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    cs.elements,
    CASE
        WHEN cs.has_co THEN 'Co-based gamma-prime candidate'
        ELSE 'Ni3Al replacement candidate'
    END AS candidate_type,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.lattice_a,
    s.lattice_b,
    s.lattice_c,
    s.volume_per_atom,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable AS phase_stable,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh,
    et.youngs_modulus,
    et.poisson_ratio,
    et.is_stable AS elastic_stable
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition_summary cs
    ON cs.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        LOWER(s.prototype) LIKE '%l1%2%'
        OR LOWER(s.prototype) LIKE '%l12%'
        OR LOWER(s.strukturbericht) IN ('l12', 'l1_2')
        OR s.space_group_number = 221
    )
    AND cs.n_elements = 2
    AND cs.max_atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
    AND cs.min_atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
    AND COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 0) <= 0.05
    AND COALESCE(ps.is_stable, TRUE) = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(et.is_stable, TRUE) = TRUE
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND et.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.3 AND 4.1
    AND (
        NOT (cs.has_ni AND cs.has_al AND cs.n_elements = 2)
        OR cs.has_co
    )
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN cs.has_co THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS FIRST,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh DESC NULLS LAST,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC NULLS LAST,
    ABS(COALESCE(s.lattice_a, 0) - COALESCE(s.lattice_b, s.lattice_a, 0)) ASC,
    ABS(COALESCE(s.lattice_a, 0) - COALESCE(s.lattice_c, s.lattice_a, 0)) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: γ'相候補のランキングを安定性・格子整合性・バルクモジュラスの重み付きスコアで出して。
sql:
WITH gamma_ref AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            AVG(s.lattice_a) FILTER (
                WHERE me.reduced_formula = 'Ni'
                  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
                  AND (
                      s.prototype ILIKE '%fcc%'
                      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%A1%'
                      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%A1%'
                      OR s.crystal_system ILIKE '%cubic%'
                      OR s.space_group_number = 225
                  )
            ),
            AVG(s.lattice_a) FILTER (
                WHERE me.reduced_formula = 'Ni'
                  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
            ),
            3.52
        ) AS ref_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
      ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
),
stability AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        MIN(
            COALESCE(
                ps.energy_above_hull,
                pde.hull_distance,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(ps.is_stable, pde.is_on_hull, FALSE) THEN 0.0
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            )
        ) AS energy_above_hull,
        MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
        BOOL_OR(COALESCE(ps.is_stable, pde.is_on_hull, FALSE)) AS is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
      ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde
      ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
    GROUP BY me.entry_id
),
elastic AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        AVG(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh
    FROM elastic_tensor
    WHERE bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.lattice_a,
        gr.ref_lattice_a,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - gr.ref_lattice_a) / NULLIF(gr.ref_lattice_a, 0) AS lattice_mismatch,
        st.energy_above_hull,
        st.formation_energy_per_atom,
        st.is_stable,
        el.bulk_modulus_vrh
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
      ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN stability st
      ON st.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic el
      ON el.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN gamma_ref gr
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND gr.ref_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND st.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          s.crystal_system ILIKE '%cubic%'
          OR s.space_group_number BETWEEN 195 AND 230
      )
      AND (
          EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM material_alloy_system mas
              WHERE mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
                AND (
                    mas.phase ILIKE '%γ%'
                    OR mas.phase ILIKE '%gamma%'
                    OR mas.phase ILIKE '%gamma%prime%'
                    OR mas.phase ILIKE '%gamma-prime%'
                    OR mas.phase ILIKE '%g-prime%'
                    OR mas.phase ILIKE '%L12%'
                    OR mas.phase ILIKE '%L1_2%'
                  )
          )
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
          OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
          OR (
              EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM composition c
                  WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
                    AND c.element = 'Ni'
              )
              AND COALESCE(me.number_of_elements, 2) >= 2
          )
      )
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        COALESCE(
            1.0 - (
                (c.energy_above_hull - MIN(c.energy_above_hull) OVER ())
                / NULLIF(MAX(c.energy_above_hull) OVER () - MIN(c.energy_above_hull) OVER (), 0)
            ),
            1.0
        ) AS stability_score,
        COALESCE(
            1.0 - (
                (c.lattice_mismatch - MIN(c.lattice_mismatch) OVER ())
                / NULLIF(MAX(c.lattice_mismatch) OVER () - MIN(c.lattice_mismatch) OVER (), 0)
            ),
            1.0
        ) AS lattice_match_score,
        CASE
            WHEN c.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NULL THEN 0.5
            ELSE COALESCE(
                (c.bulk_modulus_vrh - MIN(c.bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER ())
                / NULLIF(MAX(c.bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER () - MIN(c.bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER (), 0),
                1.0
            )
        END AS bulk_modulus_score
    FROM candidates c
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            (
                0.50 * stability_score
              + 0.30 * lattice_match_score
              + 0.20 * bulk_modulus_score
            ) DESC,
            energy_above_hull ASC,
            lattice_mismatch ASC,
            bulk_modulus_vrh DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    space_group_number,
    lattice_a,
    ref_lattice_a,
    lattice_mismatch,
    energy_above_hull,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    is_stable,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    stability_score,
    lattice_match_score,
    bulk_modulus_score,
    (
        0.50 * stability_score
      + 0.30 * lattice_match_score
      + 0.20 * bulk_modulus_score
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY
    weighted_score DESC,
    energy_above_hull ASC,
    lattice_mismatch ASC,
    bulk_modulus_vrh DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物の元素組み合わせと安定性の関係をAサイト・Bサイト別に集計して材料設計の指針を得たい。
sql:
SELECT
    a.element AS a_site_element,
    b.element AS b_site_element,
    ea.category AS a_site_element_category,
    eb.category AS b_site_element_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS n_l12_entries,
    COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable) AS n_stable_entries,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id), 0),
        3
    ) AS stable_fraction,
    ROUND(AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom)::numeric, 4) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
    ROUND(AVG(ps.energy_above_hull)::numeric, 4) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
    ROUND(MIN(ps.energy_above_hull)::numeric, 4) AS min_energy_above_hull,
    ROUND(AVG(ps.band_gap)::numeric, 4) AS avg_band_gap,
    ROUND(AVG(ABS(ea.electronegativity - eb.electronegativity))::numeric, 4) AS avg_electronegativity_difference,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            ABS(ea.atomic_radius - eb.atomic_radius)
            / NULLIF((ea.atomic_radius + eb.atomic_radius) / 2.0, 0)
        )::numeric,
        4
    ) AS avg_atomic_radius_mismatch
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition a
    ON a.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND a.site_label ILIKE 'A%'
JOIN composition b
    ON b.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND b.site_label ILIKE 'B%'
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN element ea
    ON ea.symbol = a.element
JOIN element eb
    ON eb.symbol = b.element
WHERE
    s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
GROUP BY
    a.element,
    b.element,
    ea.category,
    eb.category
ORDER BY
    stable_fraction DESC,
    avg_energy_above_hull ASC,
    n_l12_entries DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni3Alの格子定数に近く、バルクモジュラスが高く、安定なL1₂候補を総合的にランキングして。
析出強化に適したL1₂化合物を格子ミスマッチ、弾性率、安定性の多基準で評価して上位候補を出して。
Co基超合金のγ'相候補として、Co含有で安定なL1₂化合物をNi3Alとの比較で評価して。
L1₂型化合物データベースから、バルクモジュラスとせん断弾性率の比(B/G比)を計算して延性候補を抽出して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    et.calculation_id,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh, 0) AS b_g_ratio,
    et.poisson_ratio,
    et.youngs_modulus,
    et.is_stable AS elastic_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable AS phase_stable
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2') ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['L12', 'L1_2', 'L1-2'])
        OR REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2') ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%L12%', '%L1_2%', '%L1-2%', '%Cu3Au%'])
    )
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND et.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND et.shear_modulus_vrh > 0
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh, 0) >= 1.75
ORDER BY
    b_g_ratio DESC,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物の安定性マップ（formation energy vs energy above hull）を出力して、候補を4象限に分類して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS x_formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull AS y_energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0 THEN
            'Q1: negative formation energy / on hull'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0 THEN
            'Q2: negative formation energy / above hull'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0 THEN
            'Q3: nonnegative formation energy / on hull'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0 THEN
            'Q4: nonnegative formation energy / above hull'
    END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
ORDER BY
    stability_quadrant,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

question: 元素周期の観点から、3d遷移金属と4d/5d遷移金属をAサイトに持つL1₂化合物の安定性傾向を比較して。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    s.formula_type,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
  FROM material_entry me
  JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE
    me.number_of_elements = 2
    AND (
      COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ~* 'L1[_ -]?2|L12|L1₂'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ~* 'L1[_ -]?2|L12|L1₂|Cu[[:space:]]*3[[:space:]]*Au|Cu3Au|AuCu3'
      OR regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.formula_type, ''), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
      OR (
        s.space_group_number = 221
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c25
          WHERE c25.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c25.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
        )
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c75
          WHERE c75.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c75.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
        )
      )
    )
),
l12_a_site_entries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    le.entry_id,
    CASE
      WHEN e.period_number = 4 THEN '3d transition metal on A site'
      WHEN e.period_number IN (5, 6) THEN '4d/5d transition metal on A site'
    END AS a_site_period_group,
    le.formation_energy_per_atom,
    le.energy_above_hull,
    le.is_stable
  FROM l12_entries le
  JOIN composition c
    ON c.entry_id = le.entry_id
  JOIN element e
    ON e.symbol = c.element
  WHERE
    e.period_number IN (4, 5, 6)
    AND (
      e.block = 'd'
      OR e.group_number BETWEEN 3 AND 12
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(c.site_label, '') ILIKE 'A%'
      OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c_a
          WHERE c_a.entry_id = le.entry_id
            AND COALESCE(c_a.site_label, '') ILIKE 'A%'
        )
        AND (
          c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
          OR (
            regexp_replace(COALESCE(le.formula_type, ''), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'AB3'
            AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
          )
          OR (
            le.formula_type IS NULL
            AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.80
          )
        )
      )
    )
)
SELECT
  a_site_period_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id) AS num_l12_compounds,
  AVG(formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY formation_energy_per_atom) AS median_formation_energy_per_atom,
  AVG(energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY energy_above_hull) AS median_energy_above_hull,
  AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN is_stable IS TRUE THEN 1.0
      WHEN is_stable IS FALSE THEN 0.0
    END
  ) AS stable_fraction,
  MIN(energy_above_hull) AS min_energy_above_hull,
  MAX(energy_above_hull) AS max_energy_above_hull
FROM l12_a_site_entries
GROUP BY a_site_period_group
ORDER BY a_site_period_group
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂化合物のうちNi3Alより安定でバルクモジュラスが高い候補を出して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom,
        MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) AS ni3al_energy_above_hull,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
            OR (
                me.chemical_system IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM composition cni
                    WHERE
                        cni.entry_id = me.entry_id
                        AND cni.element = 'Ni'
                        AND cni.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.73 AND 0.77
                )
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM composition cal
                    WHERE
                        cal.entry_id = me.entry_id
                        AND cal.element = 'Al'
                        AND cal.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.23 AND 0.27
                )
            )
        )
        AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
        AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
        AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
),
l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.formula_type
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            upper(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', '')) = 'L12'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%2%'
            OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
                AND upper(coalesce(s.formula_type, '')) IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
            )
        )
)
SELECT
    lc.entry_id,
    lc.formula,
    lc.reduced_formula,
    lc.chemical_system,
    lc.prototype,
    lc.strukturbericht,
    lc.space_group_number,
    lc.crystal_system,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    nr.ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom,
    nr.ni3al_energy_above_hull,
    nr.ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM l12_candidates lc
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = lc.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et
    ON et.entry_id = lc.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref nr
WHERE
    NOT (
        lc.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        OR lc.chemical_system IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
    )
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
    AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND nr.ni3al_energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
    AND nr.ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh > nr.ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
    AND (
        ps.energy_above_hull <= nr.ni3al_energy_above_hull + 0.025
        OR ps.is_stable = TRUE
        OR ps.formation_energy_per_atom < nr.ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom
    )
ORDER BY
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Co-Al-W系L1₂候補の安定性と弾性特性を評価して。
sql:
WITH comp AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Co') AS has_co,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Al') AS has_al,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'W')  AS has_w,
        BOOL_OR(c.element NOT IN ('Co', 'Al', 'W')) AS has_other_element
    FROM composition AS c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group,
    s.crystal_system,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable AS thermodynamically_stable,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh,
    et.youngs_modulus,
    et.poisson_ratio,
    et.is_stable AS elastically_stable,
    c.method,
    c.functional,
    CASE
        WHEN s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu_3Au%'
          OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
          OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
          OR s.space_group_number = 221
          OR s.space_group ILIKE '%Pm-3m%'
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS l12_like
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN comp
    ON comp.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN calculation AS c
    ON c.calculation_id = et.calculation_id
WHERE
    comp.has_co = TRUE
    AND (comp.has_al = TRUE OR comp.has_w = TRUE)
    AND comp.has_other_element = FALSE
    AND me.number_of_elements BETWEEN 2 AND 3
ORDER BY
    l12_like DESC,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    ps.is_stable DESC NULLS LAST,
    et.is_stable DESC NULLS LAST,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC NULLS LAST

question: 全L1₂化合物について、安定性スコア×格子整合性スコア×弾性スコアの複合スコアを計算してランキングして。
Ni3Al代替γ'相候補をバルクモジュラス、形成エネルギー、格子ミスマッチの3軸パレート面で出力して。
L1₂型化合物データベースから材料設計仮説を導出するため、安定化合物の元素分布とその物性傾向を包括的に集計して。
sql:
WITH stable_l12 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        ps.is_stable = TRUE
        AND (
            s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        )
),
entry_properties AS (
    SELECT
        sl.entry_id,
        AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
        AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
        AVG(ps.band_gap) AS avg_phase_band_gap,
        AVG(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS avg_bulk_modulus_vrh,
        AVG(et.shear_modulus_vrh) AS avg_shear_modulus_vrh,
        AVG(et.youngs_modulus) AS avg_youngs_modulus,
        AVG(et.poisson_ratio) AS avg_poisson_ratio,
        BOOL_OR(et.is_stable) AS elastic_stable,
        AVG(tp.debye_temperature_k) AS avg_debye_temperature_k,
        AVG(tp.thermal_conductivity) AS avg_thermal_conductivity,
        AVG(tp.specific_heat_cv) AS avg_specific_heat_cv,
        AVG(tp.gruneisen_parameter) AS avg_gruneisen_parameter,
        AVG(mp.total_magnetization) AS avg_total_magnetization,
        AVG(mp.curie_temperature_k) AS avg_curie_temperature_k,
        AVG(mp.magnetic_anisotropy_energy) AS avg_magnetic_anisotropy_energy,
        AVG(dos.total_dos_at_fermi) AS avg_total_dos_at_fermi,
        BOOL_OR(dos.is_metallic) AS is_metallic,
        AVG(bs.cbm_energy - bs.vbm_energy) AS avg_band_structure_gap
    FROM stable_l12 sl
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = sl.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = sl.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN thermal_property tp
        ON tp.entry_id = sl.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN magnetic_property mp
        ON mp.entry_id = sl.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN density_of_states dos
        ON dos.entry_id = sl.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN band_structure bs
        ON bs.entry_id = sl.entry_id
    GROUP BY sl.entry_id
),
composition_roles AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        c.element,
        CASE
            WHEN c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5 THEN 'majority_sublattice_candidate'
            ELSE 'minority_sublattice_candidate'
        END AS l12_composition_role,
        c.atomic_fraction
    FROM composition c
    JOIN stable_l12 sl
        ON sl.entry_id = c.entry_id
)
SELECT
    cr.element,
    e.name AS element_name,
    e.category AS element_category,
    e.group_number,
    e.period_number,
    e.block,
    cr.l12_composition_role,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.entry_id)::numeric
        / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stable_l12), 0),
        4
    ) AS fraction_of_stable_l12_set,
    ROUND(AVG(cr.atomic_fraction)::numeric, 4) AS avg_atomic_fraction,
    ROUND(MIN(cr.atomic_fraction)::numeric, 4) AS min_atomic_fraction,
    ROUND(MAX(cr.atomic_fraction)::numeric, 4) AS max_atomic_fraction,
    ROUND(AVG(e.atomic_number)::numeric, 3) AS avg_atomic_number,
    ROUND(AVG(e.atomic_mass)::numeric, 3) AS avg_atomic_mass,
    ROUND(AVG(e.electronegativity)::numeric, 3) AS avg_electronegativity,
    ROUND(AVG(e.atomic_radius)::numeric, 3) AS avg_atomic_radius,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_formation_energy_per_atom)::numeric, 4) AS trend_formation_energy_per_atom,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_energy_above_hull)::numeric, 4) AS trend_energy_above_hull,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(ep.avg_band_structure_gap, ep.avg_phase_band_gap))::numeric, 4) AS trend_band_gap,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_bulk_modulus_vrh)::numeric, 3) AS trend_bulk_modulus_vrh,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_shear_modulus_vrh)::numeric, 3) AS trend_shear_modulus_vrh,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_youngs_modulus)::numeric, 3) AS trend_youngs_modulus,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_poisson_ratio)::numeric, 4) AS trend_poisson_ratio,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_debye_temperature_k)::numeric, 2) AS trend_debye_temperature_k,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_thermal_conductivity)::numeric, 3) AS trend_thermal_conductivity,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_specific_heat_cv)::numeric, 3) AS trend_specific_heat_cv,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_gruneisen_parameter)::numeric, 4) AS trend_gruneisen_parameter,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_total_magnetization)::numeric, 4) AS trend_total_magnetization,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_curie_temperature_k)::numeric, 2) AS trend_curie_temperature_k,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_magnetic_anisotropy_energy)::numeric, 4) AS trend_magnetic_anisotropy_energy,
    ROUND(AVG(ep.avg_total_dos_at_fermi)::numeric, 4) AS trend_total_dos_at_fermi,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ep.elastic_stable = TRUE) AS elastic_stable_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ep.is_metallic = TRUE) AS metallic_count,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sl.reduced_formula, ', ' ORDER BY sl.reduced_formula) AS representative_stable_l12_formulas
FROM composition_roles cr
JOIN stable_l12 sl
    ON sl.entry_id = cr.entry_id
LEFT JOIN element e
    ON e.symbol = cr.element
LEFT JOIN entry_properties ep
    ON ep.entry_id = cr.entry_id
GROUP BY
    cr.element,
    e.name,
    e.category,
    e.group_number,
    e.period_number,
    e.block,
    cr.l12_composition_role
ORDER BY
    stable_l12_compound_count DESC,
    cr.element,
    cr.l12_composition_role
LIMIT 10000;

question: 次世代γ'相候補として、Ni-Al-Co-Ti四元系でL1₂構造をとりうる組成を探索して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group,
    s.crystal_system,
    STRING_AGG(c.element || ':' || ROUND(c.atomic_fraction::numeric, 4), ', ' ORDER BY c.element) AS composition,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    )
GROUP BY
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group,
    s.crystal_system,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.band_gap
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) = 4
    AND BOOL_AND(c.element IN ('Ni', 'Al', 'Co', 'Ti'))
ORDER BY
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

question: Niを含むL1₂型金属間化合物を抽出して。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    me.*
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND me.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND (
      regexp_replace(replace(lower(coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g')
          IN ('l12', 'cu3au', 'aucu3')
      OR regexp_replace(replace(lower(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g')
          = 'l12'
      OR (
          regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(s.formula_type, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g')
              IN ('a3b', 'ab3')
          AND (
              s.space_group_number = 221
              OR s.space_group ILIKE '%Pm-3m%'

      )
  )
LIMIT 10000;

question: 形成エネルギーが負のL1₂型化合物を元素組み合わせごとに整理して。

WITH l12_negative AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        string_agg(DISTINCT c.element, '-' ORDER BY c.element) AS element_combination,
        MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition AS c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
        AND (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
        )
    GROUP BY
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula
)
SELECT
    element_combination,
    COUNT(*) AS compound_count,
    jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'entry_id', entry_id,
            'formula', formula,
            'formation_energy_per_atom', formation_energy_per_atom
        )
        ORDER BY formation_energy_per_atom, formula
    ) AS compounds
FROM l12_negative
GROUP BY element_combination
ORDER BY element_combination
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Alに近い格子定数を持つL1₂化合物を探して。

WITH ni3al_ref AS (

    WHERE me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3', 'Ni₃Al')

question: 格子体積が12Å³/atom以下のL1₂化合物を出して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht AS strukturbericht_designation,
    s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    s.volume_per_atom <= 12
    AND regexp_replace(
            replace(upper(concat_ws(' ', s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, s.formula_type)), '₂', '2'),
            '[^A-Z0-9]',
            '',
            'g'
        ) LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY
    s.volume_per_atom ASC,
    me.formula
LIMIT 10000;

question: 2元素系のL1₂型化合物をchemical_systemで分類して。
sql:
WITH binary_l12_entries AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.chemical_system,
        me.formula
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition AS c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1\_2' ESCAPE '\'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1\_2%' ESCAPE '\'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    GROUP BY
        me.entry_id,
        me.chemical_system,
        me.formula
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) = 2
)
SELECT
    chemical_system,
    COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id) AS compound_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT formula ORDER BY formula) AS compounds
FROM binary_l12_entries
GROUP BY chemical_system
ORDER BY chemical_system
LIMIT 10000;

question: 安定なL1₂型化合物のうち格子定数が大きい順に並べて。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, s.prototype) AS structure_type,
    s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        OR (
            s.formula_type ILIKE 'A3B'
            AND s.space_group_number = 221
        )
    )
ORDER BY
    s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni基超合金のγ'相候補として有望な、安定または準安定なL1₂型化合物を抽出して。

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,

    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht AS strukturbericht_designation,
    s.space_group_number,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS c_ni
    ON c_ni.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
WHERE
    (
        s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
        OR s.strukturbericht = 'L1_2'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'

        OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
    )

    ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物において、Aサイト元素とBサイト元素の組み合わせが形成エネルギーに与える傾向を調べて。
sql:
WITH l12_binary AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        c.element,
        c.atomic_fraction::numeric
            / NULLIF(SUM(c.atomic_fraction::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY me.entry_id), 0) AS atomic_fraction,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY me.entry_id) AS element_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY me.entry_id
            ORDER BY c.atomic_fraction::numeric DESC NULLS LAST, c.element
        ) AS site_rank
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition AS c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE s.prototype ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%L1_2%', '%L12%', '%L1₂%', '%Cu3Au%'])
      AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND c.atomic_fraction IS NOT NULL
),
ab_sites AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        formula,
        formation_energy_per_atom,
        MAX(element) FILTER (WHERE site_rank = 1) AS a_site_element,
        MAX(element) FILTER (WHERE site_rank = 2) AS b_site_element,
        MAX(atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE site_rank = 1) AS a_site_fraction,
        MAX(atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE site_rank = 2) AS b_site_fraction,
        MAX(element_count) AS element_count
    FROM l12_binary
    GROUP BY
        entry_id,
        formula,
        formation_energy_per_atom
)
SELECT
    a_site_element,
    b_site_element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id) AS compound_count,
    AVG(formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY formation_energy_per_atom) AS median_formation_energy_per_atom,
    MIN(formation_energy_per_atom) AS min_formation_energy_per_atom,
    MAX(formation_energy_per_atom) AS max_formation_energy_per_atom,
    STDDEV_SAMP(formation_energy_per_atom) AS stddev_formation_energy_per_atom,
    ARRAY_AGG(formula ORDER BY formation_energy_per_atom) AS formulas_ordered_by_formation_energy
FROM ab_sites
WHERE element_count = 2
  AND a_site_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
  AND b_site_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
GROUP BY
    a_site_element,
    b_site_element
ORDER BY
    avg_formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂構造を持つ化合物のうち、格子定数がNi₃Alに近く、形成エネルギーが低い候補を抽出して。
sql:
WITH ni3al AS (
    SELECT s.lattice_a AS a_ref
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE (
            regexp_replace(COALESCE(me.formula, ''), '\s+', '', 'g') IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
         OR regexp_replace(COALESCE(me.reduced_formula, ''), '\s+', '', 'g') IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g') ILIKE 'L12'
              OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
              OR s.space_group_number = 221
              OR COALESCE(s.space_group, '') ILIKE '%Pm-3m%'
            THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END,
        s.entry_id
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.prototype,
    s.space_group,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.lattice_a,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy,
    'eV/atom' AS formation_energy_unit,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - ni3al.a_ref) AS lattice_a_difference,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - ni3al.a_ref) / NULLIF(ni3al.a_ref, 0) * 100.0 AS lattice_a_difference_percent
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al
WHERE (
        regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g') ILIKE 'L12'
     OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
     OR s.space_group_number = 221
     OR COALESCE(s.space_group, '') ILIKE '%Pm-3m%'
)
  AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(me.formula, ''), '\s+', '', 'g') NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(me.reduced_formula, ''), '\s+', '', 'g') NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - ni3al.a_ref) / NULLIF(ni3al.a_ref, 0) <= 0.10
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    lattice_a_difference_percent ASC;

question: Aサイト元素別にL1₂型化合物の平均格子定数を集計して。
sql:
WITH l12_structures AS (
  SELECT
    s.entry_id,
    s.lattice_a,
    UPPER(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
        TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.formula_type, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
        '[^[:alnum:]]',
        '',
        'g'
      )
    ) AS norm_formula_type
  FROM material_entry AS me
  JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      UPPER(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
          '[^[:alnum:]]',
          '',
          'g'
        )
      ) = 'L12'
      OR UPPER(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
          '[^[:alnum:]]',
          '',
          'g'
        )
      ) LIKE '%CU3AU%'
      OR (
        s.space_group_number = 221
        AND UPPER(
          REGEXP_REPLACE(
            TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.formula_type, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
            '[^[:alnum:]]',
            '',
            'g'
          )
        ) IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
      )
    )
),
a_site_composition AS (
  SELECT
    entry_id,
    lattice_a,
    element
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ls.entry_id,
      ls.lattice_a,
      c.element,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY ls.entry_id, ls.lattice_a
        ORDER BY
          CASE
            WHEN c.site_label ILIKE 'A%' THEN 0
            WHEN ls.norm_formula_type = 'AB3'
              AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30 THEN 1
            WHEN ls.norm_formula_type <> 'AB3'
              AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80 THEN 1
            ELSE 2
          END,
          CASE
            WHEN ls.norm_formula_type = 'AB3' THEN ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.25)
            ELSE ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.75)
          END NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM l12_structures AS ls
    JOIN composition AS c
      ON c.entry_id = ls.entry_id
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  element AS a_site_element,
  AVG(lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_constant,
  COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id) AS compound_count
FROM a_site_composition
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物でバルクモジュラスが180GPa以上のものを抽出して。

question: Co基L1₂化合物のうち、Ni₃Alに近い格子定数のものを安定性順に出して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
      ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂', 'Cu3Au')
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.lattice_a,
    r.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
  AND s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂', 'Cu3Au')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) <= 0.02 * r.ni3al_lattice_a
ORDER BY
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST,
    lattice_a_difference ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni含有L1₂化合物のバルクモジュラスと形成エネルギーの関係を出して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS comp
    WHERE comp.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND comp.element = 'Ni'
)
AND (
    s.prototype ILIKE 'L1_2'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L12'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L1₂'
)
AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom, et.bulk_modulus_vrh
LIMIT 10000;

question: 安定なL1₂化合物をAサイト元素でグループ化し、各グループの平均形成エネルギーを出して。
sql:

    c.element AS a_site_element,
    AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE (
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(
            TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
            '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
        )) = 'l12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        OR LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(
            TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
            '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
        )) LIKE '%l12%'
    )
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
        c.site_label ILIKE 'A'
        OR c.site_label ILIKE 'A-site'
        OR c.site_label ILIKE 'A_site'
    )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物の格子定数と形成エネルギーの相関を見たい。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant_a_angstrom,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    corr(
        s.lattice_a::double precision,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom::double precision
    ) OVER () AS pearson_correlation
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE (

question: L1₂化合物の格子ミスマッチ（Ni3Alとの差）を計算して小さい順に表示して。
sql:
WITH ref AS (
    SELECT
        s_ref.lattice_a AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry AS me_ref
    JOIN structure AS s_ref
        ON s_ref.entry_id = me_ref.entry_id
    WHERE (
        me_ref.formula ILIKE 'Ni3Al'
        OR me_ref.formula ILIKE 'AlNi3'
        OR me_ref.reduced_formula ILIKE 'Ni3Al'
        OR me_ref.reduced_formula ILIKE 'AlNi3'
    )
      AND s_ref.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN s_ref.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
              OR s_ref.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
              OR s_ref.prototype ILIKE '%L1-2%'
              OR s_ref.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
              OR s_ref.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
              OR s_ref.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
              OR s_ref.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
              OR s_ref.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1-2%'
              OR s_ref.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END,
        s_ref.structure_id
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant_a,
    ref.ni3al_lattice_a,
    s.lattice_a - ref.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_difference,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - ref.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_mismatch
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ref
WHERE (
    s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1-2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1-2%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
)
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (
      me.formula ILIKE 'Ni3Al'
      OR me.formula ILIKE 'AlNi3'
      OR me.reduced_formula ILIKE 'Ni3Al'
      OR me.reduced_formula ILIKE 'AlNi3'
  )
ORDER BY lattice_mismatch ASC;

question: L1₂化合物で安定性と格子定数の両面でNi3Alに近い候補を出して。
sql:
WITH target AS (
    SELECT
        ps.energy_above_hull AS target_energy_above_hull,
        s.lattice_a AS target_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
          s.prototype ILIKE 'L1_2'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L12'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L1₂'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
      )
    ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(ps.energy_above_hull - t.target_energy_above_hull) AS stability_difference,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - t.target_lattice_a) AS lattice_constant_difference,
    (
        ABS(ps.energy_above_hull - t.target_energy_above_hull)
        + ABS(s.lattice_a - t.target_lattice_a) / NULLIF(t.target_lattice_a, 0)
    ) AS similarity_score
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN target t
WHERE me.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  AND (
      s.prototype ILIKE 'L1_2'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L12'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L1₂'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
  )
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY similarity_score ASC
LIMIT 20;

question: 遷移金属を含むL1₂型化合物のうち安定なものを出して。

    me.entry_id,

    ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry AS pde
    ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%cP4%221%'
        OR (
            s.space_group_number = 221
            AND (
                s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
                OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
            )
        )
    )
    AND (
        ps.is_stable IS TRUE
        OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.0
        OR pde.is_on_hull IS TRUE
        OR pde.hull_distance <= 0.0
    )
    AND EXISTS (

        WHERE

    )

question: L1₂型金属間化合物において、相安定性、格子ミスマッチ、弾性特性を同時に考慮した析出強化相候補を抽出して。
sql:
WITH comp AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        element,
        SUM(atomic_fraction) AS atomic_fraction
    FROM composition
    WHERE atomic_fraction IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY entry_id, element
),
comp_summary AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        COUNT(*) AS n_elements,
        MIN(atomic_fraction) AS min_atomic_fraction,
        MAX(atomic_fraction) AS max_atomic_fraction
    FROM comp
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.formula_type,
        COALESCE(s.lattice_a, s.lattice_b, s.lattice_c) AS lattice_a,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.poisson_ratio,
        et.is_stable,
        cs.n_elements,
        cs.min_atomic_fraction,
        cs.max_atomic_fraction
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN comp_summary AS cs
        ON cs.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
            OR regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
            OR regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%cu3au%'
            OR regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%aucu3%'
            OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
                AND (
                    s.formula_type IN ('A3B', 'AB3', 'A_3B', 'AB_3')
                    OR (
                        cs.n_elements = 2
                        AND cs.min_atomic_fraction > 0
                        AND cs.max_atomic_fraction / cs.min_atomic_fraction BETWEEN 2.5 AND 3.5
                    )
                )
            )
        )
        AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
        AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.25
        AND (
            ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NULL
            OR ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0.10
        )
        AND et.is_stable IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
        AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
        AND et.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
        AND et.youngs_modulus IS NOT NULL
        AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh > 0
        AND et.shear_modulus_vrh > 0
        AND et.youngs_modulus > 0
        AND COALESCE(s.lattice_a, s.lattice_b, s.lattice_c) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    prototype AS structure_type,
    strukturbericht,
    space_group AS space_group_symbol,
    space_group_number,
    lattice_a AS lattice_parameter_a,
    100.0 * (lattice_a - 3.52) / 3.52 AS lattice_mismatch_to_fcc_ni_percent,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    energy_above_hull,
    bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus,
    shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus,
    youngs_modulus,
    poisson_ratio,
    is_stable
FROM l12_candidates
ORDER BY
    energy_above_hull ASC,
    ABS(100.0 * (lattice_a - 3.52) / 3.52) ASC,
    shear_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Al代替またはCo基γ'相候補として有望なL1₂型金属間化合物を、形成エネルギー、格子定数、弾性率の観点から探索して。
sql:
WITH comp AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        COUNT(*) AS n_elements,
        STRING_AGG(c.element, '-' ORDER BY c.element) AS chemical_system,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) AS max_atomic_fraction,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Co') AS contains_co,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Ni') AS contains_ni,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Al') AS contains_al
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    comp.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.lattice_a,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh,
    et.youngs_modulus_vrh,
    ROUND(
        (
            40.0 * GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0) / 0.05)
          + 25.0 * GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.20)
          + 25.0 * LEAST(COALESCE(et.youngs_modulus_vrh, et.bulk_modulus_vrh, 0.0) / 250.0, 1.0)
          + 10.0 * CASE WHEN comp.contains_co THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
        )::numeric,
        2
    ) AS candidate_score
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN comp
    ON comp.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        ps1.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps1.energy_above_hull
    FROM phase_stability ps1
    WHERE ps1.entry_id = me.entry_id
    ORDER BY ps1.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
) ps ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        et1.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et1.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et1.youngs_modulus AS youngs_modulus_vrh
    FROM elastic_tensor et1
    WHERE et1.entry_id = me.entry_id
    ORDER BY et1.calculation_id DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
) et ON TRUE
WHERE
    (
        LOWER(s.prototype) IN ('l12', 'l1_2', 'cu3au')
        OR LOWER(s.prototype) LIKE '%l1_2%'
        OR LOWER(s.prototype) LIKE '%l12%'
        OR LOWER(s.prototype) LIKE '%cu3au%'
        OR LOWER(s.strukturbericht) IN ('l12', 'l1_2')
        OR (
            s.space_group_number = 221
            AND s.formula_type IN ('AB3', 'A3B')
        )
    )
    AND comp.n_elements BETWEEN 2 AND 4
    AND comp.max_atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.65 AND 0.85
    AND me.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.10
    AND (ps.energy_above_hull IS NULL OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05)
    AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.45 AND 3.85
    AND (
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh >= 120.0
        OR et.youngs_modulus_vrh >= 150.0
    )
ORDER BY
    candidate_score DESC,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC;

question: L1₂型化合物の元素組み合わせと安定性の関係をAサイト・Bサイト別に集計して材料設計の指針を得たい。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
),
ranked_composition AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        c.element,
        c.atomic_fraction,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.entry_id
            ORDER BY c.atomic_fraction DESC, c.element
        ) AS site_rank
    FROM composition AS c
    JOIN l12_entries AS l12
        ON l12.entry_id = c.entry_id
),
site_assignment AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        MAX(element) FILTER (WHERE site_rank = 1) AS a_site_element,
        MAX(element) FILTER (WHERE site_rank = 2) AS b_site_element,
        MAX(atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE site_rank = 1) AS a_site_fraction,
        MAX(atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE site_rank = 2) AS b_site_fraction
    FROM ranked_composition
    GROUP BY entry_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT
    sa.a_site_element,
    sa.b_site_element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l12.entry_id) AS compound_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT l12.formula ORDER BY l12.formula) AS formulas,
    AVG(sa.a_site_fraction) AS avg_a_site_fraction,
    AVG(sa.b_site_fraction) AS avg_b_site_fraction,
    AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
    MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS min_formation_energy_per_atom,
    AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
    MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) AS min_energy_above_hull,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.025) AS stable_or_near_stable_count,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.025)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        3
    ) AS stable_or_near_stable_fraction,
    CASE
        WHEN MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) <= 0.025
             AND AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) < 0
            THEN 'promising'
        WHEN MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) <= 0.050
            THEN 'borderline'
        ELSE 'less_promising'
    END AS design_guideline
FROM l12_entries AS l12
JOIN site_assignment AS sa
    ON sa.entry_id = l12.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = l12.entry_id
GROUP BY
    sa.a_site_element,
    sa.b_site_element
ORDER BY
    stable_or_near_stable_fraction DESC,
    min_energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    avg_formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST,
    compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni3Alの格子定数に近く、バルクモジュラスが高く、安定なL1₂候補を総合的にランキングして。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.formula = 'Ni3Al'
      AND (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
      )
),
l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.source_material_id AS material_name,
        s.structure_id,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht AS strukturbericht_designation,
        s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.lattice_a,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
        ps.energy_above_hull AS energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_atom,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - nr.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_abs_diff,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - nr.ni3al_lattice_a) / NULLIF(nr.ni3al_lattice_a, 0) AS lattice_a_rel_diff
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref nr
    WHERE me.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
      AND (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
      )
      AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
      AND nr.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        1.0 - CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY c.lattice_a_abs_diff ASC) AS lattice_match_score,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY c.bulk_modulus_gpa ASC) AS bulk_modulus_score,
        1.0 - CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY c.energy_above_hull_ev_atom ASC) AS stability_score
    FROM l12_candidates c
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            (
                0.40 * lattice_match_score
              + 0.35 * bulk_modulus_score
              + 0.25 * stability_score
            ) DESC,
            lattice_a_abs_diff ASC,
            bulk_modulus_gpa DESC,
            energy_above_hull_ev_atom ASC
    ) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    material_name,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht_designation,
    space_group_symbol,
    space_group_number,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_a_abs_diff,
    lattice_a_rel_diff,
    bulk_modulus_gpa,
    energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
    formation_energy_ev_atom,
    lattice_match_score,
    bulk_modulus_score,
    stability_score,
    (
        0.40 * lattice_match_score
      + 0.35 * bulk_modulus_score
      + 0.25 * stability_score
    ) AS overall_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY
    overall_score DESC,
    lattice_a_abs_diff ASC,
    bulk_modulus_gpa DESC,
    energy_above_hull_ev_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 析出強化に適したL1₂化合物を格子ミスマッチ、弾性率、安定性の多基準で評価して上位候補を出して。
sql:
WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        s.lattice_a AS l12_lattice_a,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
        ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
            OR s.space_group_number = 221
        )
        AND s.crystal_system ILIKE '%cubic%'
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
),
fcc_matrix AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id AS matrix_entry_id,
        me.formula AS matrix_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        s.lattice_a AS matrix_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
        ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%fcc%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%cubic close%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%A1%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%fcc%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%A1%'
            OR s.space_group_number = 225
        )
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
),
matched AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.entry_id)
        c.entry_id,
        c.formula,
        m.matrix_entry_id,
        m.matrix_formula,
        c.l12_lattice_a,
        m.matrix_lattice_a,
        100.0 * ABS(c.l12_lattice_a - m.matrix_lattice_a) / NULLIF(m.matrix_lattice_a, 0) AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
        c.bulk_modulus,
        c.shear_modulus,
        c.youngs_modulus,
        c.energy_above_hull,
        c.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM l12_candidates c
    LEFT JOIN fcc_matrix m
        ON (
                m.alloy_system_id = c.alloy_system_id
             OR m.chemical_system = c.chemical_system
           )
       AND m.matrix_entry_id <> c.entry_id
    WHERE
        c.youngs_modulus IS NOT NULL
        AND c.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY
        c.entry_id,
        100.0 * ABS(c.l12_lattice_a - m.matrix_lattice_a) / NULLIF(m.matrix_lattice_a, 0) NULLS LAST
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(
            1.0 - CUME_DIST() OVER (
                ORDER BY lattice_mismatch_percent ASC NULLS LAST
            ),
            0.0
        ) AS mismatch_score,
        COALESCE(
            CUME_DIST() OVER (
                ORDER BY youngs_modulus ASC NULLS LAST
            ),
            0.0
        ) AS modulus_score,
        COALESCE(
            1.0 - CUME_DIST() OVER (
                ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
            ),
            0.0
        ) AS stability_score
    FROM matched
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    matrix_entry_id,
    matrix_formula,
    ROUND(l12_lattice_a::numeric, 4) AS l12_lattice_a,
    ROUND(matrix_lattice_a::numeric, 4) AS matrix_lattice_a,
    ROUND(lattice_mismatch_percent::numeric, 4) AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
    ROUND(youngs_modulus::numeric, 2) AS youngs_modulus,
    ROUND(bulk_modulus::numeric, 2) AS bulk_modulus,
    ROUND(shear_modulus::numeric, 2) AS shear_modulus,
    ROUND(energy_above_hull::numeric, 5) AS energy_above_hull,
    ROUND(formation_energy_per_atom::numeric, 5) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
    ROUND(
        (
            0.40 * mismatch_score
          + 0.30 * modulus_score
          + 0.30 * stability_score
        )::numeric,
        4
    ) AS precipitation_strengthening_score
FROM scored
WHERE
    energy_above_hull <= 0.20
ORDER BY
    precipitation_strengthening_score DESC,
    lattice_mismatch_percent ASC NULLS LAST,
    energy_above_hull ASC,
    youngs_modulus DESC
LIMIT 20;

question: Co基超合金のγ'相候補として、Co含有で安定なL1₂化合物をNi3Alとの比較で評価して。
sql:
WITH composition_summary AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        SUM(c.atomic_fraction) AS total_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(c.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.element = 'Co'), 0) AS co_amount
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
l12_materials AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        cs.co_amount / NULLIF(cs.total_amount, 0) AS co_atomic_fraction,
        s.prototype,
        s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.lattice_a AS lattice_parameter_a,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull AS energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus_gpa,
        et.youngs_modulus AS youngs_modulus_gpa,
        et.poisson_ratio
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN composition_summary cs
        ON cs.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '-', '')) IN ('l12', 'l1₂', 'cu3au')
            OR LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '-', '')) IN ('l12', 'l1₂')
            OR s.space_group_number = 221
        )
        AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.025
),
ni3al_reference AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM l12_materials
    WHERE formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    ORDER BY energy_above_hull_ev_atom ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    cand.entry_id,
    cand.formula,
    cand.co_atomic_fraction,
    cand.prototype,
    cand.space_group_symbol,
    cand.space_group_number,
    cand.energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
    cand.formation_energy_ev_atom,
    cand.lattice_parameter_a,
    ref.lattice_parameter_a AS ni3al_lattice_parameter_a,
    100.0 * (cand.lattice_parameter_a - ref.lattice_parameter_a)
        / NULLIF(ref.lattice_parameter_a, 0) AS lattice_mismatch_vs_ni3al_pct,
    cand.bulk_modulus_gpa,
    ref.bulk_modulus_gpa AS ni3al_bulk_modulus_gpa,
    cand.bulk_modulus_gpa / NULLIF(ref.bulk_modulus_gpa, 0) AS bulk_modulus_ratio_vs_ni3al,
    cand.shear_modulus_gpa,
    ref.shear_modulus_gpa AS ni3al_shear_modulus_gpa,
    cand.shear_modulus_gpa / NULLIF(ref.shear_modulus_gpa, 0) AS shear_modulus_ratio_vs_ni3al,
    cand.youngs_modulus_gpa,
    ref.youngs_modulus_gpa AS ni3al_youngs_modulus_gpa,
    cand.youngs_modulus_gpa / NULLIF(ref.youngs_modulus_gpa, 0) AS youngs_modulus_ratio_vs_ni3al,
    cand.poisson_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN cand.energy_above_hull_ev_atom <= 0.005
             AND ABS(100.0 * (cand.lattice_parameter_a - ref.lattice_parameter_a)
                 / NULLIF(ref.lattice_parameter_a, 0)) <= 2.0
             AND cand.shear_modulus_gpa >= 0.8 * ref.shear_modulus_gpa
            THEN 'high-priority Co-base gamma-prime candidate'
        WHEN cand.energy_above_hull_ev_atom <= 0.025
             AND ABS(100.0 * (cand.lattice_parameter_a - ref.lattice_parameter_a)
                 / NULLIF(ref.lattice_parameter_a, 0)) <= 5.0
            THEN 'possible Co-base gamma-prime candidate'
        ELSE 'stable L12 Co-containing compound; check mismatch/mechanics'
    END AS candidate_assessment
FROM l12_materials cand
CROSS JOIN ni3al_reference ref
WHERE
    cand.co_atomic_fraction > 0
    AND cand.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
ORDER BY
    cand.energy_above_hull_ev_atom ASC,
    ABS(100.0 * (cand.lattice_parameter_a - ref.lattice_parameter_a)
        / NULLIF(ref.lattice_parameter_a, 0)) ASC,
    cand.shear_modulus_gpa DESC NULLS LAST;

question: L1₂型化合物データベースから、バルクモジュラスとせん断弾性率の比(B/G比)を計算して延性候補を抽出して。

question: L1₂型化合物の安定性マップ（formation energy vs energy above hull）を出力して、候補を4象限に分類して。
sql:
WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        s.structure_id,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy,
        ps.energy_above_hull
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE 'L1_2'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L12'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        )
        AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
        AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
),
thresholds AS (
    SELECT
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY formation_energy) AS median_formation_energy,
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY energy_above_hull) AS median_energy_above_hull
    FROM l12_candidates
)
SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.formula,
    c.formation_energy,
    c.energy_above_hull,
    CASE
        WHEN c.formation_energy <= t.median_formation_energy
         AND c.energy_above_hull <= t.median_energy_above_hull
            THEN 'Q1: low formation energy / low energy above hull'
        WHEN c.formation_energy > t.median_formation_energy
         AND c.energy_above_hull <= t.median_energy_above_hull
            THEN 'Q2: high formation energy / low energy above hull'
        WHEN c.formation_energy <= t.median_formation_energy
         AND c.energy_above_hull > t.median_energy_above_hull
            THEN 'Q3: low formation energy / high energy above hull'
        ELSE 'Q4: high formation energy / high energy above hull'
    END AS stability_quadrant
FROM l12_candidates AS c
CROSS JOIN thresholds AS t
ORDER BY
    c.energy_above_hull ASC,
    c.formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni基超合金のγ'相代替候補として、Ni-Al系以外で安定なL1₂化合物を格子整合性で評価して。
sql:
WITH comp AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        string_agg(c.element, '-' ORDER BY c.element) AS chemical_system,
        bool_or(c.element = 'Ni') AS has_ni,
        bool_or(c.element = 'Al') AS has_al,
        count(DISTINCT c.element) AS n_elements,
        min(c.atomic_fraction) AS min_atomic_fraction,
        max(c.atomic_fraction) AS max_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
ni_gamma AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT s.lattice_a
                FROM material_entry me
                JOIN comp cp
                    ON cp.entry_id = me.entry_id
                JOIN structure s
                    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
                LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
                    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
                WHERE cp.has_ni
                  AND cp.n_elements = 1
                  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.space_group_number = 225
                          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%fcc%'
                          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Fm-3m%'
                          OR s.space_group ILIKE '%Fm-3m%'
                        THEN 0
                        ELSE 1
                    END,
                    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            3.52
        ) AS a_ni
),
l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        cp.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN comp cp
        ON cp.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT (cp.has_ni AND cp.has_al)
      AND (
            ps.is_stable = TRUE
         OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
      )
      AND (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%AuCu₃%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu₃Au%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
         OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
            AND cp.n_elements = 2
            AND (
                    s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
                 OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
                 OR (
                        cp.max_atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
                    AND cp.min_atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
                    )
                )
            )
      )
)
SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.formula,
    c.chemical_system,
    c.prototype,
    c.space_group_number,
    c.lattice_a AS l12_lattice_a,
    n.a_ni AS gamma_ni_lattice_a,
    100.0 * (c.lattice_a - n.a_ni) / n.a_ni AS lattice_misfit_percent,
    abs(100.0 * (c.lattice_a - n.a_ni) / n.a_ni) AS abs_lattice_misfit_percent,
    c.energy_above_hull,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM l12_candidates c
CROSS JOIN ni_gamma n
ORDER BY
    abs_lattice_misfit_percent ASC,
    c.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST;
