question: 元素周期の観点から、3d遷移金属と4d/5d遷移金属をAサイトに持つL1₂化合物の安定性傾向を比較して。
sql:
WITH l12_a_site_compounds AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        e.symbol AS a_site_element,
        e.period_number AS period,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition AS c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN element AS e
        ON e.symbol = c.element
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE 'L1_2'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L12'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        )
        AND c.site_label = 'A'
        AND e.group_number BETWEEN 3 AND 12
        AND e.period_number IN (4, 5, 6)
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN period = 4 THEN '3d transition metal on A site'
        WHEN period IN (5, 6) THEN '4d/5d transition metal on A site'
    END AS a_site_period_class,
    COUNT(*) AS compound_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE energy_above_hull <= 0.025) AS stable_or_near_stable_count,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE energy_above_hull <= 0.025) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS stable_or_near_stable_percent,
    ROUND(AVG(energy_above_hull)::numeric, 4) AS avg_energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY energy_above_hull)::numeric, 4) AS median_energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
    ROUND(AVG(formation_energy_per_atom)::numeric, 4) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_atom
FROM l12_a_site_compounds
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN period = 4 THEN '3d transition metal on A site'
        WHEN period IN (5, 6) THEN '4d/5d transition metal on A site'
    END
ORDER BY a_site_period_class
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂化合物のうちNi3Alより安定でバルクモジュラスが高い候補を出して。
sql:
WITH ni3al AS (
    SELECT
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS ref_formation_energy_per_atom,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS ref_bulk_modulus
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
          s.prototype ILIKE 'L1_2'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L12'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L1₂'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
      )
    ORDER BY
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al
WHERE (
        s.prototype ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE 'L1₂'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
    )
  AND me.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < ni3al.ref_formation_energy_per_atom
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh > ni3al.ref_bulk_modulus
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC;

question: Co-Al-W系L1₂候補の安定性と弾性特性を評価して。
sql:
WITH co_al_w_entries AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        string_agg(
            c.element || '=' || to_char(c.atomic_fraction, 'FM0.0000'),
            ', ' ORDER BY c.element
        ) AS composition
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) = 3
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) FILTER (WHERE c.element IN ('Co', 'Al', 'W')) = 3
),
l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM structure s
    WHERE upper(replace(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
       OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
       OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1%2%'
       OR (
            s.space_group_number = 221
        AND s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
       )
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.source_material_id AS material_id,
    me.formula,
    e.composition AS co_al_w_composition,
    als.system_name AS alloy_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
    s.crystal_system,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    ps.is_stable AS phase_stability_flag,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull IS NULL THEN 'stability data unavailable'
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.025 THEN 'stable or near-hull L12 candidate'
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.050 THEN 'metastable L12 candidate'
        ELSE 'thermodynamically unstable L12 candidate'
    END AS stability_assessment,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus_gpa,
    et.youngs_modulus AS youngs_modulus_gpa,
    et.poisson_ratio,
    ROUND((et.bulk_modulus_vrh / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh, 0))::numeric, 3) AS pugh_ratio,
    et.is_stable AS elastic_stability_flag,
    CASE
        WHEN et.is_stable IS NULL THEN 'elastic data unavailable'
        WHEN et.is_stable THEN 'mechanically stable'
        ELSE 'mechanically unstable'
    END AS elastic_stability_assessment,
    CASE
        WHEN et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NULL OR et.shear_modulus_vrh IS NULL THEN 'ductility data unavailable'
        WHEN et.bulk_modulus_vrh / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh, 0) >= 1.75 THEN 'ductile by Pugh criterion'
        ELSE 'brittle by Pugh criterion'
    END AS ductility_assessment,
    et.calculation_id AS elastic_calculation_id
FROM co_al_w_entries e
JOIN material_entry me
  ON me.entry_id = e.entry_id
JOIN l12_candidates s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
  ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN alloy_system als
  ON als.alloy_system_id = mas.alloy_system_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ps1.*
    FROM phase_stability ps1
    WHERE ps1.entry_id = me.entry_id
    ORDER BY ps1.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
) ps ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT et1.*
    FROM elastic_tensor et1
    WHERE et1.entry_id = me.entry_id
    ORDER BY et1.calculation_id DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
) et ON true
ORDER BY
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC NULLS LAST;

question: 全L1₂化合物について、安定性スコア×格子整合性スコア×弾性スコアの複合スコアを計算してランキングして。
sql:
WITH l12_materials AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE upper(replace(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) IN ('L12', 'L1')
       OR upper(replace(replace(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) IN ('L12', 'L1')
),
score_components AS (
    SELECT
        lm.entry_id,
        lm.formula,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN ps.is_stable THEN 1.0
                WHEN ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0))
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS stability_score,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
                 AND s.lattice_b IS NOT NULL
                 AND s.lattice_c IS NOT NULL
                 AND NULLIF((s.lattice_a + s.lattice_b + s.lattice_c) / 3.0, 0.0) IS NOT NULL
                THEN 1.0 / (
                    1.0 +
                    (
                        abs(s.lattice_a - s.lattice_b)
                      + abs(s.lattice_a - s.lattice_c)
                      + abs(s.lattice_b - s.lattice_c)
                    ) / NULLIF((s.lattice_a + s.lattice_b + s.lattice_c) / 3.0, 0.0)
                )
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS lattice_matching_score,
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN et.is_stable IS FALSE THEN 0.0
                WHEN et.youngs_modulus IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(et.youngs_modulus, 0.0) / (1.0 + GREATEST(et.youngs_modulus, 0.0))
                WHEN et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(et.bulk_modulus_vrh, 0.0) / (1.0 + GREATEST(et.bulk_modulus_vrh, 0.0))
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS elastic_score
    FROM l12_materials AS lm
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = lm.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = lm.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
        ON et.entry_id = lm.entry_id
    GROUP BY
        lm.entry_id,
        lm.formula
),
composite_scores AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        formula,
        stability_score,
        lattice_matching_score,
        elastic_score,
        stability_score * lattice_matching_score * elastic_score AS composite_score
    FROM score_components
)
SELECT
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    stability_score,
    lattice_matching_score,
    elastic_score,
    composite_score
FROM composite_scores
ORDER BY
    composite_score DESC NULLS LAST,
    entry_id
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni3Al代替γ'相候補をバルクモジュラス、形成エネルギー、格子ミスマッチの3軸パレート面で出力して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS lattice_a
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
      ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
            LOWER(s.prototype) IN ('l12', 'l1_2', 'cu3au')
         OR s.space_group_number = 221
      )
),
stoich AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        STRING_AGG(c.element, '-' ORDER BY c.element) AS elements,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) AS max_atomic_fraction,
        MIN(c.atomic_fraction) AS min_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition AS c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
       AND MAX(c.atomic_fraction) BETWEEN 0.73 AND 0.77
       AND MIN(c.atomic_fraction) BETWEEN 0.23 AND 0.27
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        st.elements,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
        MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
        MIN(100.0 * ABS(s.lattice_a - nr.lattice_a) / nr.lattice_a) AS lattice_mismatch_percent
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN stoich AS st
      ON st.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN structure AS s
      ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
      ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
      ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref AS nr
    WHERE me.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
            LOWER(s.prototype) IN ('l12', 'l1_2', 'cu3au')
         OR s.space_group_number = 221
      )
      AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
      AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND nr.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        st.elements
),
pareto AS (
    SELECT c.*
    FROM candidates AS c
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM candidates AS d
        WHERE d.entry_id <> c.entry_id
          AND d.bulk_modulus_gpa >= c.bulk_modulus_gpa
          AND d.formation_energy_ev_per_atom <= c.formation_energy_ev_per_atom
          AND d.lattice_mismatch_percent <= c.lattice_mismatch_percent
          AND (
                d.bulk_modulus_gpa > c.bulk_modulus_gpa
             OR d.formation_energy_ev_per_atom < c.formation_energy_ev_per_atom
             OR d.lattice_mismatch_percent < c.lattice_mismatch_percent
          )
    )
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    elements,
    bulk_modulus_gpa,
    formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    lattice_mismatch_percent
FROM pareto
ORDER BY
    lattice_mismatch_percent ASC,
    formation_energy_ev_per_atom ASC,
    bulk_modulus_gpa DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物データベースから材料設計仮説を導出するため、安定化合物の元素分布とその物性傾向を包括的に集計して。
sql:
WITH stable_l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%L12%'
        )
        AND (
            ps.is_stable = TRUE
            OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.025
        )
),
entry_properties AS (
    SELECT
        sle.entry_id,

        MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_atom,

        AVG(cp.value) FILTER (
            WHERE cp.property_name ILIKE '%formation_energy%'
        ) AS formation_energy_ev_atom,

        AVG(cp.value) FILTER (
            WHERE cp.property_name ILIKE '%band_gap%'
        ) AS band_gap_ev,

        AVG(cp.value) FILTER (
            WHERE cp.property_name ILIKE '%bulk_modulus%'
        ) AS bulk_modulus_gpa,

        AVG(cp.value) FILTER (
            WHERE cp.property_name ILIKE '%shear_modulus%'
        ) AS shear_modulus_gpa,

        AVG(cp.value) FILTER (
            WHERE cp.property_name ILIKE '%young%'
        ) AS young_modulus_gpa,

        AVG(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS elastic_bulk_modulus_gpa,
        AVG(et.shear_modulus_vrh) AS elastic_shear_modulus_gpa,
        AVG(et.youngs_modulus) AS elastic_young_modulus_gpa,

        AVG(tp.debye_temperature_k) AS debye_temperature_k,
        AVG(tp.thermal_conductivity) AS thermal_conductivity_w_mk,

        AVG(mp.total_magnetization) AS magnetic_moment_mu_b,
        AVG(mp.curie_temperature_k) AS curie_temperature_k

    FROM stable_l12_entries AS sle
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = sle.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN calculation AS calc
        ON calc.entry_id = sle.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN calculated_property AS cp
        ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
        ON et.entry_id = sle.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN thermal_property AS tp
        ON tp.entry_id = sle.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN magnetic_property AS mp
        ON mp.entry_id = sle.entry_id
    GROUP BY
        sle.entry_id
),
composition_labeled AS (
    SELECT
        sle.entry_id,
        sle.formula,
        c.element,
        c.atomic_fraction,
        CASE
            WHEN c.atomic_fraction >= 0.50 THEN 'majority_sublattice_A'
            ELSE 'minority_sublattice_B'
        END AS l12_site_role
    FROM stable_l12_entries AS sle
    JOIN composition AS c
        ON c.entry_id = sle.entry_id
)
SELECT
    cl.element,
    e.atomic_number,
    e.period_number,
    e.group_number,
    cl.l12_site_role,

    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT cl.entry_id)::numeric
        / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stable_l12_entries), 0),
        4
    ) AS occurrence_fraction_among_stable_l12,

    AVG(cl.atomic_fraction) AS avg_atomic_fraction,
    MIN(cl.atomic_fraction) AS min_atomic_fraction,
    MAX(cl.atomic_fraction) AS max_atomic_fraction,

    AVG(ep.energy_above_hull_ev_atom) AS avg_energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
    STDDEV_POP(ep.energy_above_hull_ev_atom) AS stddev_energy_above_hull_ev_atom,

    AVG(ep.formation_energy_ev_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_atom,
    STDDEV_POP(ep.formation_energy_ev_atom) AS stddev_formation_energy_ev_atom,

    AVG(ep.band_gap_ev) AS avg_band_gap_ev,
    STDDEV_POP(ep.band_gap_ev) AS stddev_band_gap_ev,

    AVG(COALESCE(ep.elastic_bulk_modulus_gpa, ep.bulk_modulus_gpa)) AS avg_bulk_modulus_gpa,
    STDDEV_POP(COALESCE(ep.elastic_bulk_modulus_gpa, ep.bulk_modulus_gpa)) AS stddev_bulk_modulus_gpa,

    AVG(COALESCE(ep.elastic_shear_modulus_gpa, ep.shear_modulus_gpa)) AS avg_shear_modulus_gpa,
    STDDEV_POP(COALESCE(ep.elastic_shear_modulus_gpa, ep.shear_modulus_gpa)) AS stddev_shear_modulus_gpa,

    AVG(COALESCE(ep.elastic_young_modulus_gpa, ep.young_modulus_gpa)) AS avg_young_modulus_gpa,
    STDDEV_POP(COALESCE(ep.elastic_young_modulus_gpa, ep.young_modulus_gpa)) AS stddev_young_modulus_gpa,

    AVG(ep.debye_temperature_k) AS avg_debye_temperature_k,
    STDDEV_POP(ep.debye_temperature_k) AS stddev_debye_temperature_k,

    AVG(ep.thermal_conductivity_w_mk) AS avg_thermal_conductivity_w_mk,
    STDDEV_POP(ep.thermal_conductivity_w_mk) AS stddev_thermal_conductivity_w_mk,

    AVG(ep.magnetic_moment_mu_b) AS avg_magnetic_moment_mu_b,
    STDDEV_POP(ep.magnetic_moment_mu_b) AS stddev_magnetic_moment_mu_b,

    AVG(ep.curie_temperature_k) AS avg_curie_temperature_k,
    STDDEV_POP(ep.curie_temperature_k) AS stddev_curie_temperature_k,

    JSONB_AGG(
        DISTINCT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'entry_id', cl.entry_id,
            'formula', cl.formula,
            'atomic_fraction', cl.atomic_fraction,
            'energy_above_hull_ev_atom', ep.energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
            'formation_energy_ev_atom', ep.formation_energy_ev_atom,
            'band_gap_ev', ep.band_gap_ev,
            'bulk_modulus_gpa', COALESCE(ep.elastic_bulk_modulus_gpa, ep.bulk_modulus_gpa),
            'shear_modulus_gpa', COALESCE(ep.elastic_shear_modulus_gpa, ep.shear_modulus_gpa),
            'young_modulus_gpa', COALESCE(ep.elastic_young_modulus_gpa, ep.young_modulus_gpa),
            'debye_temperature_k', ep.debye_temperature_k,
            'thermal_conductivity_w_mk', ep.thermal_conductivity_w_mk,
            'magnetic_moment_mu_b', ep.magnetic_moment_mu_b,
            'curie_temperature_k', ep.curie_temperature_k
        )
    ) AS supporting_compounds

FROM composition_labeled AS cl
JOIN element AS e
    ON e.symbol = cl.element
LEFT JOIN entry_properties AS ep
    ON ep.entry_id = cl.entry_id
GROUP BY
    cl.element,
    e.atomic_number,
    e.period_number,
    e.group_number,
    cl.l12_site_role
ORDER BY
    stable_l12_compound_count DESC,
    cl.l12_site_role,
    cl.element
LIMIT 10000;

question: 次世代γ'相候補として、Ni-Al-Co-Ti四元系でL1₂構造をとりうる組成を探索して。
sql:
WITH comp_by_element AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        c.element,
        SUM(c.atomic_fraction) AS atomic_fraction
    FROM composition AS c
    GROUP BY
        c.entry_id,
        c.element
),
comp_summary AS (
    SELECT
        cbe.entry_id,
        jsonb_object_agg(cbe.element, cbe.atomic_fraction ORDER BY cbe.element) AS composition,
        COUNT(*) AS num_elements,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE cbe.element IN ('Ni', 'Al', 'Co', 'Ti')
        ) AS target_element_count,
        BOOL_OR(cbe.element = 'Ni') AS has_ni,
        BOOL_OR(cbe.element = 'Al') AS has_al,
        BOOL_OR(cbe.element NOT IN ('Ni', 'Al', 'Co', 'Ti')) AS has_non_target_element
    FROM comp_by_element AS cbe
    GROUP BY
        cbe.entry_id
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    cs.composition,
    cs.num_elements,
    cs.target_element_count,
    s.strukturbericht AS structure_type,
    s.prototype,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group AS space_group_symbol,
    s.space_group_number,
    ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN comp_summary AS cs
    ON cs.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    cs.has_ni
    AND cs.has_al
    AND cs.num_elements BETWEEN 2 AND 4
    AND cs.target_element_count >= 2
    AND NOT cs.has_non_target_element
    AND (
        regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE ANY (
            ARRAY[
                '%l12%',
                '%cu3au%',
                '%aucu3%'
            ]
        )
        OR regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE ANY (
            ARRAY[
                '%l12%',
                '%cu3au%',
                '%aucu3%',
                '%ni3al%',
                '%alni3%'
            ]
        )
        OR lower(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '')) ILIKE ANY (
            ARRAY[
                '%gamma''%',
                '%gamma prime%',
                '%gamma-prime%',
                '%γ''%',
                '%γ prime%',
                '%γ-prime%'
            ]
        )
        OR lower(coalesce(s.prototype, '')) ILIKE ANY (
            ARRAY[
                '%gamma''%',
                '%gamma prime%',
                '%gamma-prime%',
                '%γ''%',
                '%γ prime%',
                '%γ-prime%'
            ]
        )
        OR (
            s.space_group_number = 221
            AND regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(s.formula_type, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE ANY (
                ARRAY[
                    '%a3b%',
                    '%ab3%'
                ]
            )
        )
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM material_alloy_system AS mas
            WHERE
                mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
                AND (
                    mas.phase ILIKE ANY (
                        ARRAY[
                            '%L12%',
                            '%L1_2%',
                            '%L1-2%',
                            '%L1 2%',
                            '%L1₂%',
                            '%Cu3Au%',
                            '%AuCu3%',
                            '%gamma''%',
                            '%gamma prime%',
                            '%gamma-prime%',
                            '%γ''%',
                            '%γ prime%',
                            '%γ-prime%'
                        ]
                    )
                    OR mas.composition_type ILIKE ANY (
                        ARRAY[
                            '%L12%',
                            '%L1_2%',
                            '%L1-2%',
                            '%L1 2%',
                            '%L1₂%',
                            '%gamma''%',
                            '%gamma prime%',
                            '%gamma-prime%',
                            '%γ''%',
                            '%γ prime%',
                            '%γ-prime%'
                        ]
                    )
                )
        )
    )
ORDER BY
    cs.target_element_count DESC,
    cs.num_elements DESC,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    me.entry_id
LIMIT 10000;
